charger did not answer. On that day, it seemed like everything in the world was quietly turning its back on Yeon-i.

The part-time job interview was canceled that day. The assignment file was broken right before submission. The delivery went to another building. The moment I tried to use the cafe coupon, it expired yesterday.

Small misfortunes eroded Yeon's day little by little every day. At first I laughed it off as a coincidence. However, if coincidences overlap for a few days, the back of your neck becomes cold as if someone is standing behind you. If you fail, it's fate, if you break up, it's not meant to be, if it's too late, it's not the right time... Those words always left me alone.
If you say that, the explanation becomes easier. But my heart doesn't feel any easier.

episodes.tag: Episode 1 · I became a flower pig
episodes.title: became a flower pig

beats.t: The fall suddenly became soft, and light enveloped the body. The arms became shorter and the fingers became stubby. And when she opened her eyes — she was in the middle of a big lotus boat floating on the river.
I'm a pig!
The scream spread long over the river like the night sky. And then it suddenly stopped. There isn't much lung capacity left in this body to even scream.

The lotus leaf was unbelievably large. It was wider than most studio beds, and dew formed on the edges like lights. There were no oars, no sails, no engines. Just a huge lotus leaf. But it was floating. Even, reliably.

Yeoni looked down at her body for a long time. Short paws. Round belly. Curly tail. A small flower blooming on top of your head. No matter how you looked at the pink body, it did not belong to a human.
No. … How do I do my homework with these hands?
At that moment, a strange sound was mixed at the end of the words.
This really doesn't make sense, honey.
Yeon-i froze on the spot.
… … What did you just say?
Hello. I am human.
It was fine. Yeon was very, very relieved.
Good. It makes sense. Fortunately,
But soon, I looked at the front foot again.
… The finger disappeared.
This is a clear downgrade. From a human with ten fingers to a pig with two front paws.
A little while ago, she was in her room. Wet socks, weird apps, tarot moons. And now — pig with flowers. To be exact, a flower pig.
Yeoni flopped down on the lotus leaf. The soft body was slightly pressed and returned. The sensation was so vivid that I hated it even more.
Okay. okay. … This is a dream.
It was obvious. No matter how strange the world is these days, turning a person into a pig just because he or she clicked on an app incorrectly is crossing a line.
Yeon tapped the bottom of the lotus leaf with her front foot. There was a sense of touch.
If it's a dream, you have to pinch yourself to wake it up. … The front paws don't touch the face.
… The graphics are nice.
She concluded very seriously. Since the limited event was held until 3 a.m. yesterday, this is an obvious aftereffect of the game.
status window.
Nothing appeared.
menu. … Inventory.
Only the wind passed by. Yeon narrowed her eyes.
… The UI is unfriendly. One star.
At that time, a low voice was heard from the tip of the lotus leaf.
Denial of reality is a long way.
Yeon-i froze. I slowly turned my head. There was something sitting on the tip of the lotus leaf.
At first I thought it was a white cat. Its body was small and sleek, and it had a long tail. But at the nape of his neck—there was a golden mane. It's a cat, and it has a mane.
… What are you?
I am Neo.
Is it a cat?
No.
Are you a lion?
To put it bluntly, it is closer to a lion.
But why is it so small? Just use the palm of your hand.
Neo's eyebrows twitched.
… From the first meeting, you were rude.
I was just dragged into another world and became a pig. For today, I think you have the right to be rude.
Neo was silent for a moment.
… I admit that.
Are you an NPC?
No.
NPCs always say that.
… What you said just now sounds like an NPC line.
I am the guardian who protects the river in the sandbar.
… It's an NPC with settings.
Yeoni pressed the flower above her head with her front paw. The petals swayed slightly. The touch was clear. It was so vivid.
Ah. The details are crazy.
Does it hurt?
It doesn't hurt, but it feels weird.
Then it is reality.
That decision is too rough.

Instead of answering, Neo looked outside the ship. Yeon followed suit and turned her head. Only then did I see my surroundings clearly.
It was a

river. But it was no ordinary river. The water was dark blue and brown, starlight broke with each wave, and unfamiliar Chinese characters swam like fish in the water. Gapja, Eulchuk, Byeongin, Jeongmyo — these were letters that I wanted to give up as soon as they appeared in the test range.
There was fog in the distance, and beyond it stood vague pillar-like figures. A big moon in the sky. The moonlight was strangely not cold. It was pretty. Ridiculous. … So I was even more scared.
If it's a dream, just wake up. If it's a game, just turn it off. But here, it was like a dream that I didn't know how to turn off.

… Where are you?
River at
Key.
This is where the code of human destiny flows.
Yes. I don't know anything.
is normal. Most people who come here for the first time are like that.
I'm no longer human.
To be exact, it is a flower pig.
The more I hear that word, the worse I feel.
It's better than just a pig, isn't it?
… Is that comforting?
This is an objective analysis.
Yeon took a deep breath. A small snort came out. Gulp. It was such a cute sound. I suddenly became angry at the fact that such a sound came out of my mouth.
Why a pig? … And where am I, I want to go home.
It's not easy.
Easy answer, I didn't expect it.
Neo walked slowly on the lotus leaves. Every time I stepped on it, the floor glowed a little. Star-shaped pattern on the toes. It didn't seem like it was just a cat that made strange noises.
Neo. Are you in charge here?
is similar.
Then I will file a complaint. Isn’t it too much to turn a person into a pig for clicking on an app?
It's kind of cute, isn't it?
complaint added. … And what I clicked on was the app. Code What are you talking about?
Neo's expression hardened a little.

That's the door.
It looks like the
app.
These days, it just appears in a form that is easy for humans to click. Because I'd rather press an app than open a door.
Yeon-i was speechless. That's true, it made me feel worse.
At that time, the river water below the boat shook greatly. with a splash. Yeon-i lowered her body reflexively.
Just now, what?
Neo's eyes changed. It seemed like a troublesome cat before, but now it was different. The tip of the mane glowed faintly, golden.
Remnants of bad luck. … These are things that have leaked out of your reality.
My… reality?
Neo pointed to a place where black ink was spreading above the river. The black water swallowed each passing letter one by one. The shining Chinese characters turned black and became distorted.
Lately, my luck has been messed up.
Alarm did not go off. A card that bounced three times. Triangle kimbap without filling. Corrupted assignment file. A broken promise. Apps that could not be deleted. — The moment Yeoni was speechless.

I passed it all off as a joke, but in fact, I was still worried in a corner of my mind. Why is it so twisted? Why am I the only one whose timing is not right? Why does something that is nothing always break as if it bypasses me?
That’s… Is this related to this?
Your destiny code has been damaged. It means that the four four main characters have been scattered.
Who touched my fortune? why. There's no need to say there's anything there.
To figure it out, you first have to get the four letters back.
Before Neo could finish speaking, a black hand rose from beneath the river. Too long to be a hand, too vivid to be a shadow. A hand made of black water tried to grab the edge of the lotus leaf.
Yeon-i froze. My heart sank. The joke I had been holding onto until just now disappeared completely from my mind. That wasn't the decoration of a dream. Something was coming to get me.
That… Are you coming for me?
That's right.
Why.
Because you are the target.
Why do you say that so calmly?
A black hand stretched out over the stomach. Yeon tried to back away, but her body still felt like it belonged to someone else. My short legs wandered around on the lotus leaf.
No, why is this body control so bad!
operation takes some getting used to.

The moment the black hand was about to grab Yeon-i — Neo disappeared. No, it seemed to have disappeared. A golden line split the air. Okay. The black hand split in half, and droplets of ink scattered.
Neo landed on the tip of a lotus leaf. It was a small body. But the movement just now was not small at all.
… oh.
Don't call me a cat anymore. I am a lion.
Yeon thought for a moment.
… Battle cat?
Neo's eyes narrowed.
Just call me Neo.
Okay, Neo.
The black hand did not disappear. More shadows rose from below the river. The severed hands melted into the water and came together again in a thicker and longer form.
Neo hit the bottom of the lotus leaf with his front foot. Tuk. Transparent water droplets floated around the edge, surrounding it like a small shield. A black hand scratched the shield. I'm sorry.
… The sound is the worst.
I can't last long.
Then what should I do?
… The flower above your head is alive.
Yeon touched the flower above her head. The petals touched my fingertips. At that moment, the flower glowed very faintly. It was warm. Very small, but definitely.
What is this?
Traces of four days. It is the central letter that represents yourself.
Yeon immediately gave up understanding.
Good. For now, let's just say my flower is a battery.
is not similar.
I changed it to make it easier to understand.
Wrong understanding is dangerous.
From your description, you sound like a professor who requires liberal arts.
The black hands came again. Neo looked across the river. In the fog, four lights emerged.
One is sharp and blue. One waved like a warm light. One flashed golden light. The last one glowed softly like an old bookshelf.
The four four pillars are scattered across four islands. Island of Cowardice. An island of food. Island of Jaeseong. Inseong’s library.

Yeon looked at the four lights. It was so vivid that it almost seemed tangible to be a dream, and it sent a chill down my spine to the point that it was a game. But strangely enough, it seemed like those lights were calling to him. Deep inside my heart, I was quietly shaken.
If you go through all that, you can go home.
That's right.
Wait a minute. I have never agreed to the terms and conditions.
There is no consent procedure.
Refund in the interim.
None.
inquiry bulletin board.
None.
Customer Center.
… In a way, I exist.
… I feel very uneasy about something.
Complaints are not accepted.
This is the worst customer service center.
I also do not accept star ratings.
At that time, a black hand came through the shield.
Good!
Yeon immediately covered her mouth.
… What I just said was because I was surprised.
I know.
Neo jumped up again. A golden pattern appeared on the toenails. — Saju Seong-gwang. As he swung his front paw, the starlight blade spread across the river. The black hands were cut off all at once.
The lotus leaf boat was pushed forward. The river parted as if to open a path. As soon as Neo landed, he spoke softly.
The first destination is the Island of Cowardice.
Cowardice?
It is an island with things that resemble you.
Is there anything else that resembles me?
There are many. Friends, rivals, pride, jealousy — and courage.
Yeon looked at the first light in the fog without saying a word. Rather than being beautiful, the light was sharp like glass. If I got close, it felt like I was going to get cut.
… Why do I have a bad feeling from the first island?
Facing yourself is not inherently comfortable.
… Again, you say it like a famous saying.
Because it's true.
The lotus leaf boat picked up speed. Behind, black hands tore through the river again. The fog thickened ahead. Beyond that, the shadow of the island emerged little by little. Island of Cowardice.
There were numerous small mirror fragments floating around the island. In each mirror — something was reflected.

episodes.tag: Episode 2 · A cat with a mane? Neo
episodes.title: A cat with a mane? Neo

beats.t:
The lotus leaf boat arrived at the dock on Cowardly Island. Tuk. It was a smaller sound than I thought.
The black hands that were chasing after
stopped tall in front of the island. It wiggled for a moment outside the fog, then slowly sank to the bottom of the river.
Yeon held on to the edge of the lotus leaf and took a deep breath. There was a lot of power in the short, fingerless front paws. Still, somehow, I held on.
lived… … .
A small snort escaped the end of the sentence. honey. Yeon immediately covered her mouth with her front paw.
No. What I just said was just breathing. It's not a pig sound.
Instead of answering, Neo lightly jumped down onto the dock. As the small body landed, golden footprints appeared briefly on the black glass floor and then disappeared.
Wow. As long as there are sound effects, it's a perfect game.
Do you still think of it as a game?
I haven't given up hope yet. Just show me one loading screen and I'll admit it right away.
If denying reality is a talent, it's a pretty big talent.
I'll take it as a compliment. But what are you really like? It's a cat with a mane, it's a downsized lion.
… It's a lion.
But you keep looking like a cat.
If you say it one more time, I will leave that footprint on your forehead.
Yes, lion. A lion with a cool mane.
Yeoni tried to carefully get down from the lotus leaf. The moment you step on your front foot first and try to move your hind leg—
Uh, huh?
Short legs didn't listen. Yeon buried her nose into the dock floor. puck.
It didn't hurt. Instead, my pride hurt a little.
Landing... It might take some practice.
Don't analyze.
Isn't this supposed to be a tutorial in the first place? There are no controls, no save, and at least no refund button.
At the end of his protest, his nose cleared. honey. The weight of protest was reduced by just half.
The Island of Cowardice was quiet. There was no grass, no house, no people. Instead, the entire island seemed to be made of mirror fragments.

The floor sparkled like black glass, and large and small mirrors were floating in the air. There were some as big as the palm of your hand and some as big as a door. Each mirror had a different angle.
A mirror that reflects the sky. A mirror that reflects the river. A mirror reflecting a lotus leaf pear. And—a mirror that reflects Yeon-i.
Yeoni looked into a nearby mirror. There, there was a flower pig. Pink body. A small flower placed on the head. Short paws.
It was so cute. So, I didn't like it.
I still can't get used to it.
When did your cheeks get fat like this? Who secretly put it in?
When Yeon raised her front paw, the pig in the mirror also raised its front paw. Just the left and right are reversed. When I tilted my head, the guy in the mirror tilted the same way.
Hey. Don't follow me.
Of course, the pig in the mirror also opened its mouth. There was no sound. Somehow, that was even more disgusting.
As Yeon turned her body around, her tail swayed along with it. Because it was so cute, it made me even more annoyed.
Hey, just make a mistake once. If there is any lag, I will admit that you are a fake.
Oh really.
Why are you doing that?
I'm always looking for a girl crush. After all, the genre has been replaced by healing animals.
… It's a complicated feeling.
You don't know. The feeling of a person whose entire appearance genre suddenly changed one day.
I was a perfectionist from the moment I was born.
Oh, yes. That's right.
Companion Lion Review. Two stars for personality. But because the mane is pretty... Added half a star. I saw it.
Yeon skipped it over and walked inside the island. The further inside you go, the more dense the mirror pieces become. But—it was strange.
Some mirrors did not reflect the current flower pig, Yeon-i. At first I thought I had seen something wrong. Yeon stopped.
In the mirror—there was a person.
Wet hair. Baggy hoodie. Training pants with open knees. Charger cable thrown on the bed. Cell phone in hand.
And a twenty-three-year-old college student looking down at the screen with a tired face. It was a kite. Original, Yeon-i. It was so familiar, but rather unfamiliar.
Yeoni slowly approached the mirror. Every time the front paw touched the floor, a small sound was heard.
In the mirror, Yeon-i was sitting on the bed. Just as it was in reality just a moment ago. Her hair was tied up roughly, and she had a tired look on her face. Still, that was the face Yeon knew.
Human hand. human legs. human eyes. Everything that Yeon lost was all behind one layer of the mirror.
Yeon looked down at her front feet, then looked back at the mirror. A corner of my chest felt strangely tight.
I… … It looked like that.
The voice came out quieter than expected. My throat didn't open well.
Things I had forgotten came back all at once. The feeling of sliding across the screen with your finger. A hair tie that was worn on the wrist when tying one's hair.
The frustration of taking off wet socks and throwing them away. Feeling helpless in front of the lost assignment files. All of that little stuff suddenly seemed so far away.
Yeoni lifted her front paw and placed it on the mirror. It was cold. Yeon in the mirror also raised her hand. A human palm and a short front paw touched each other with a layer of glass in between.
At that moment, Yeon was strangely moved. I wanted to go back. really.
Just now, I said half-jokingly that I wanted to go home. It was different now. Those words suddenly became real.
I want to go home. To my room. To my bed. With my fingers.
… Neo.
Yes. I'm listening.
That… … Is it really me?
Neo looked in the mirror. His expression also became a little more serious.
Yes, this is your original form.
Then, if you go in there, can you go back?
No.
The answer was quick and decisive. Yeon asked, unable to take her eyes off the mirror.
… why.
The island of cowardice The mirror is not an exit. It is a place that illuminates the places you have lost.
spot?
The place where you believed you were yourself. You are what others see. The person you wanted to be. And—the place you felt you were pushed out of.
I think I know, but I didn't want to know. So I hated it even more.
At that time, Yeon in the mirror moved. Yeon-i stopped breathing.
The mirror was clearly imitating Yeoni just a moment ago. But now—it was the opposite.
The human Yeon in the mirror was making a different expression from Yeon. A little more calmly. Stand a little straighter. A little more—unlike Yeon-yi, confidently.
It's late.
Yeon-i froze.
… … what?
You're always late.
It was a small statement. But it was as sharp as fingernails. Without realizing it, Yeon took a step back.
The alarm is also late. The reply is too late. The apology is too late. The opportunity is too late.
There was a thin crack on the surface of the mirror.
This time too—it's late.
Yeoni bit her lip.
What are you?
me? Yeon.
I hated that answer the most. Yeon tapped my chest with her front paw.
Yeon is me, right?
Really? Now, with that body?
I was speechless for a moment. I was angry, but strangely I couldn't accept it right away.
This is because Yeon-i in the mirror looked so natural. The way he was in his room. own voice. own face. Your own expression.
If someone had to choose between the two as the real Yeon-i—it would be the pink flower pig. Or is it that person?
Be careful.
What is that?
This is a reflection created by the Island of Cowardice. A competitor with the same face as you. Another you, aiming for your place.
So it's a doppelganger.
To put it simply, yes.
My life is full of real content, not a single one is missing.
I didn't come here to watch.
There is no room for you here.
The word spread throughout the island. Then the surrounding mirrors began to glow one by one. In each small mirror, a different scene was reflected.
At the back of the classroom. A place where someone sits first. Yeon’s message was posted late in the group project chat room. Unread reply.
Interview cancellation text. Screenshot of contest submission failed. And a triangular kimbap that fell on the floor of the convenience store.
Hey, leave out the triangle gimbap. That's too trivial.
It was said as a joke, but the end of the voice wavered a little. It's little things. These are all things that can be laughed off.
As it piled up, I felt like I was being pushed out. Little by little, I was pushed out of place, late, missed—and in the end, I felt like I was becoming a non-existent person.
At that time, one of the largest mirrors slowly emerged. It was different from other mirrors. There was a dark blue light, and the surface shook like water.
Yeon's original appearance stood inside it. But this time it wasn't inside the room. It was on a black river. In human form.
At Yeon's feet, a tiny sprout had sprouted. Beneath the bud, deep waves rippled.
[乙亥]
Yeon quietly looked at the two letters floating on the edge of the mirror. Strangely, I couldn't take my eyes off it.

Eulhae. It was unfamiliar, like seeing letters for the first time, but it seemed like a name I had known for a long time. There was a small sound inside my chest. The flowers above my head glowed faintly.
was found.
What.
Yes, one week. The pillar of the day you were born. The letter closest to your center.
Around the Eulhae Sea.
Around the Eulhae… … .
The moment I said those words, the flower above my head glowed a little brighter. Yeon, the human in the mirror, also saw that light. And for the first time—his expression hardened.
No.
Yeon in the mirror stretched out her hand. The letters [乙亥] in the mirror began to be drawn towards her.
Yeon, stop it!
How!
Hold on to your name!
What do you mean! Speak clearly!
This means don't lose your spot!
I don't like you right now.
Yeon-i paused.
I don't like that body either. I don't like being here. I also hate your unfortunate reality.
Yeon in the mirror took a step forward. The mirror surface swelled like water.
So—I'll do it. I am the real kite.
Yeon-i’s heart sank.
Instead of you, I'll go back.
Yeoni was out of breath. The self in the mirror looked so realistic. human appearance. A familiar face. normal hand. normal voice.
What Yeon-i lost now—that girl had it all.
If you go back to that way anyway, no one will believe it's you, right?
Those words got stuck in my throat. Yeon looked down at her front feet. Pink. short and round. It's cute, but the body doesn't look like mine.
It was a moment. Just a moment. What if that kid returns instead? What if that thing is better than me?
The thought itself made me feel a little cold.
Don't listen too carefully.
But… … .
The mirror digs into the gap where you hate yourself.
Neo stood in front of Yeon.
The Island of Cowardice is the Island of Fighting. But the other person is not someone else. It's another you, trying to take your place.
You say a lot.
Yeon in the mirror snapped her fingers. The surrounding mirror pieces flew up all at once. Sharp glass rained down on Yeon and Neo.

beats.t: The smell of money came from across the river.
It was neither fishy nor flowery. The smell of heated metal. The smell of someone's day melting away on a scale.
Lotus Leaf Even before the boat turned, Yeon knew. The next island is a place where people are counted.

The color of the river water gradually changed. It was silver in front of the Island of Cowardice and rainbow-colored in front of the Island of Food, but now it was a dull golden color. It's pretty, but somewhat dull, the color like a coin that hasn't been touched for a long time.
It's strange. It's sparkling, but why am I not excited at all?
Yeon suddenly thought of her room. The morning when the card beeped, triangle gimbap disguised as spicy pork, and an expired coupon. I felt like I was always losing half a beat when it came to money.
Neo. What is that smell? It's not my nose that's bothering me, but my wallet.
It is an island of wealth. The energy of wealth, the power to earn and hold. In fortune telling, wealth is the character that governs money and desires.
Remember. Free is the most expensive on that island.
Free is the most expensive... It's the same principle as the free tarot booth in front of our school.
Neo did not deny it. That was scarier.
The river water gradually began to sparkle yellow. It was not starlight, but the light reflected by the sunken gold coin.

Interest is charged the moment you pick it up. Hands that go down to the river bottom usually belong to the river bed.
I won't pick it up.
Yeoni quietly retracted the front foot that she was about to extend. Then, for about three seconds, I glanced sideways at the gold coin with regretful eyes.
Still watching.

What are you scared of? There is no such thing as an eyeball usage fee, right? Please tell me there isn't any.
But Neo. Our destination is the library of Inseong. Why does the ship go to Jaeseong’s island?

Inseong's library is not an island. It's a place rooted beneath Jaeseong Island. Jaegeukin, money and documents are an inseparable pair, so the two areas are connected by one root. The entrance is somewhere on that island.
Root books under the island of money. It's like having a library in the basement of a bank. The word loan also overlaps.
That joke is more accurate than I thought, so I can't correct it.
See, I sometimes say the right answer too. Please raise one star.
Ratings are not accepted. still.
The lotus leaf boat glided through the yellow river water. Under the water, gold coins followed the boat, blinking like stars. It was like a store display case enticing customers.

But it’s interesting. The island of cowardice is full of mirrors, the island of food is full of stages, and here, even the river bottom is full of money. Does each island have such different personalities?

The island is the pillar of your fortune. Cowardice is what you are, food is what you express, wealth is what you try to hold on to, character is what you lean on. When you go around the island, all four scattered letters come together.
There was so much room inside me. I thought I was the only one.
People are originally the most lost within themselves.
Just said that again. Are you really a liberal arts professor? A cat with a curriculum.

After leaving the island of food, the ship became a little quiet. The space without Mocha was bigger than I thought. The waterway without a single line of song was twice as long.

And Yeon-i had not yet forgotten the black brush marks she saw in the library. Neo's face that was close to longing as he looked at the marks.
Eventually, the fog cleared, and Jaeseong Island appeared.
The entire port was golden. The roof, signs, lanterns, and even the seagulls' beaks were all covered with gold leaf.
Wow… It's shiny? What, everyone here is rich?
Gold leaf is the thickness of a sheet of paper. The wealth of this island is also roughly the same.
A bra as thick as a sheet of paper. It's poetic. But why does it sound so cool?
The truth is originally a bit cold. Especially when it's hiding behind something shiny.

A huge golden scale sculpture stood in the port square. A pile of gold coins on one plate, and an empty plate with ‘Today’s Credit’ written on the other. People bowed their heads slightly every time they passed by. Like dealing with God.
Are you saying hello to that scale? People here really believe in scales.
It's not that I believe it, it's that I'm scared. When wealth becomes god, people lose their dignity the moment their price is set. The people of this island live and see it every day.
When I got off the dock, the sound came first. Jangle, jangle. The sound of gold coins and bargaining at every step. And click, click, the sound of the scales tipping.

Money changer booths were lined up on every pier railing. The blackboard with “Today’s Fortune Price” written on it was filled with numbers instead of people’s names. A name that has increased in value since yesterday, a name that has been cut in half.
Look at that over there. Buying and selling people's luck like stocks? If my fortune was listed, it would be on the verge of delisting by now.
Your fortune cannot be listed on this island. Fails from screening.
Was that a comfort or a diss? Judgment please.
It is an objective analysis. As always.
There were street vendors lined up in every alley. Steaming dumplings, sugar-coated fruit, and honey rice cakes sprinkled with gold leaf. Yeon’s stomach honestly growled.
Can I just eat that honey rice cake? Just one. To replenish the traveler's energy.
As Yeon approached the stall, the owner smiled and picked up a honey rice cake. And put it on the scale. Not the rice cake, but Yeon’s eyes.
Owner: 「This honey rice cake is worth one gold coin. or not… A piece of the customer’s ‘best memory of the day’.”
Can you calculate from memory?
No. Go away. If you pay the price on the island of Jaeseong with your heart, your heart will never come back.
Neo tapped Yeoni's front paw and pulled it away from the stall. The owner shrugged his shoulders regretfully and put the honey rice cake back down.
I almost got into big trouble. I almost sold my memories for one honey rice cake.
You may be able to endure hunger on this island, but if you cannot endure curiosity, you will go bankrupt. Remember.
I'll keep that in mind. But that honey rice cake looked really delicious. I will definitely buy it with gold coins later.
I'll buy it for you then. With gold coins. Rightfully so.
Huh? Neo is buying it for you? I need to write this down in my notebook as well. Second surprise today.
Every resident passing by was holding a small scale in their hands. Use a scale to buy an apple. Scales while saying hello.
Why are greetings weighed on scales? ?
It is to give back as much as received. The debt I owe on this island is heavier than my life.

At the entrance to the alley, a man was holding a scale and holding onto another man's sleeve. “I haven’t paid you back for smiling at me three years ago. “It’s two gold coins, including interest.” The captured man opened his wallet without saying a word.
Do I owe you something for smiling? So, am I being charged for laughing at Neo earlier?
Luckily, I don't do debt collection. Because your smile has low return value.
Just released the second diss. Today's savings completed.

As Yeon looked around the market, her heart kept getting colder. There were many things that sparkled, but few people smiled. Everyone had the face of mortgaging their ability to smile while trying to repay something.
Neo. People here are rich, so why don't they look happy at all?
When you get used to counting what you have, you only see what you don't have. Jaesung is such a force. If you use it well, it's a livelihood, but if you use it incorrectly, it's a prison.

At the end of those words, the tallest building in the middle of the market came into view. If other buildings were gold-plated, that building alone shined heavily like pure gold. There was a blue rabbit emblem hanging at the top.
That blue rabbit mark... It's all over the place. On the sign, and on that yellow paper.
Cheongtoki Financial Group. This is the place that holds almost all of the island's debt. Be careful. What you borrow here is not money, but time.

Just then, a bell rang on one side of the square. People stopped what they were doing and stuck to the wall. In the middle of the road, a group of people dressed in gray clothes were being led in a line.
Everyone's eyes were open. A chain with a weight attached to the ankle. With each step, the number to be repaid made a jingling sound. In some cases, even the outline of their faces was blurred.
Why are these people like that? The face is being erased.

This is the ‘Debt Labor Volunteer Group.’ These are people who have nothing to repay, so they put themselves up as collateral. The longer you work, the more your name gets erased. If the person to pay the debt disappears, the debt disappears.
What kind of logic is that! Eliminating debt by erasing people!
It's the extreme of talent. When wealth begins to control people, people become numbers. Even if you erase the numbers, no one will feel sad.
At the end of the line, a woman passed by, pushing a heavy safe. I had not yet taken off my flour-covered apron. Yeon took a deep breath without realizing it.
Apron. bakery… ?

The woman had already disappeared far away. Yeon followed that apron with her eyes for a long time. The sight of the back of someone I hadn't even met yet strangely caught my eye.
I saw
. That is the real face of this island. There is a chain under the gold leaf. Don't take on debt carelessly. Because even kindness pays interest here.
Neo. I just decided. I won’t just pass by this island. At least one of the people erased like that will be brought back.
I don't think it will end with just one person.
Then two people. Three if you're greedy. I'm basically a nosy person.
Neo's eyes scanned the price list on the market bulletin board. And, he said it very naturally.
Interest rates will rise twice in the next 15 days. It is better to exchange money today.
How do you know that? The price list only has today's price.
Neo's ears twitched for just a moment.
statistics.
Statistics are convenient. You don’t have to show any evidence.
Yeon did not ask any more questions. I just wrote one line in the notebook in my mind. Neo sometimes speaks of dates that haven't come yet as if they were yesterday.
Neo. Are you from the future?
Neo's steps stopped for a moment. It was really a half and a half beat. Other people might have missed it, but Yeoni didn't miss it.
What kind of novel are you talking about? I am just a long-lived Guardian. If you live long enough, you will see patterns.
I just stopped. For sure. Do you also write this down in your mental notebook? 'Neo, paused at the future question.'
Your notebook is very diligent.
That's it. I won't pry now. But Neo. If you ever want to talk, tell me first. I have a heavy mouth. Sometimes.
Remember that.
Instead of answering those words, Neo turned his gaze towards the river. The side of his face somehow resembled a very old longing. Yeon didn't know the name of that expression yet.
As I entered the center of the market, a commotion suddenly broke out in front.
“You’re a thief!” someone shouted, and the crowd split like waves. In the middle of it all, a small white rabbit stood holding a basket.
It was a baby rabbit wearing a pink dress, with ears that looked longer than the body. The basket smelled of freshly baked bread.
No! I didn't steal it! This is delivery! This is the bread my sister baked!
One of the men thrust the scale and growled. There was no record of paying for the six loaves.

The crowd surrounded the rabbit. Each person held a scale in their hand and looked at the child as if they were putting a price on it. “That rabbit, I heard that the bakery went bankrupt these days.” “It’s the order of the day for a kid from a bankrupt house to steal.”
No… no! There’s no need to steal my sister’s bread! Everyone lines up to buy it because it’s the most delicious in the world!
No one listened to the child. On this island, horses had to be placed on scales to gain weight, and the young rabbit's tears were always light on the scales.
Wait a minute! The kid said it was delivery! Just because you don't have a receipt doesn't mean you're a thief!
The crowd's attention was focused on the flower pig this time. Talking pigs seemed to be rare even on this island.
Could you please lend me a scale? Six loaves of bread, let’s weigh them.
Neo put the bread on the scale. And I placed the order form next to it.
The weight stated on the order form matches the actual measurement. According to my statistics, there are no cases where an order form is included with stolen items.
The crowd murmured and then dispersed. On the Island of Scales, no one could weigh what was proven by the scales.

Jangjeong, who had been growling, shyly took the scales. However, as he retreated, he spilled a word. 「… “If you get involved with a girl from a ruined family, your name will appear in the next ledger.”
Oh my, I guess they weigh threats too? I just heard that it doesn't weigh anything.
Zhang Zheng snorted and disappeared. Yeon looked at the back and stuck out her tongue. When the flower pig stuck out its tongue, it was more like a puppet show than a threat.
Provocation later. We are in a position where we cannot stand out.
A talking flower pig and a talking lion are walking around together, isn't it already bad?
I can't deny it.
Luna seemed to have finally relaxed, looking up at the two people in turn while holding the basket tightly. Big eyes sparkled with admiration.
Wow… It was just so cool! Prove it by raising the scale! Even the adults couldn’t say anything!
The cool thing is Neozi. I just screamed from the side.
Sound is also a strategy. While I was getting attention, I had the scales ready.
Huh? Did you just praise me for that? Neo? It's snowing today.
analysis.
Thank you. Black. Really, really thank you.
Don't cry. The bread is safe. All six.
Yes! The bread you bake is the most delicious in the world, so don’t lose even one!
The rabbit wiped his tears with his sleeve and immediately smiled like the sun. The transition of emotions was fast.
I am Luna! Let me and you run a bakery! Are you a traveler? This is my first time seeing a flower pig!
Yeon. Due to circumstances, I am a pig now, but I was originally a human. The cat with the mane over here is Neo.
Lion.
Wow, cats talk! Big white cat!
It's a lion.
Is your name Saja? But why does it look like a cat?
Neo gave up on rebutting. It was the second wisest decision he had made since coming to the island. The first is, of course, not picking up the river bed gold coins.
(I saw Neo lose an argument for the first time today. I should write it down in my mental notebook as a souvenir.)
Yeoni, Neo! Can I follow you? The bread delivery is over and I'm on my way to my sister's store. I think it would be fun to go together!
Of course. We would be grateful if you could show us the way. Instead, stay behind us in dangerous places.
Risk is my specialty! While delivering, I was chased by dogs three times and by gangsters twice. I beat them all!
I don't know if it's something to brag about.
I'm proud that I survived! My sister said that. Running away is also a skill.
It seems like you said a lot of nice things. What kind of person are you?
The kindest and best baker in the world! He looks just like me, but he’s taller! I'll find out later. I'm sure Yeon will like you too.

The only time Luna talked about her sister, her voice became higher. It seemed like her sister was her family and her whole world to her. Yeoni diligently teased her short legs to match the child's pace.

Luna walked ahead and introduced Jongaljongal Island. Which alley money changer is evil, which noodle restaurant gives you money without interest? The sense of geography developed through delivery was like that of an adult.
You're a complete walking map. Better than navigation.
Hehe, it's been three years since delivery! The soles of my feet memorize every alley on this island!

Luna, who was walking around an alley, suddenly stopped in front of a puddle of water, jumped up, and stepped right in the middle. with a splash. Even though the water was splashing, my clothes surprisingly did not get wet. It seemed like the water was avoiding him.
Huh? You stepped on the water, but you didn’t get wet. Is it a waterproof rabbit?
I don’t know~ I’m naturally close to water! They are also the best at delivering on rainy days. Water doesn't stick to me. My sister says I’m a water puppy.
(Water avoids that child. For Jaeseong’s island rabbit, the texture of the energy is different. It is the texture of water.)
Neo's eyes rested on Luna for a moment. His eyes recognized something, but he didn't say anything. Not yet.
And there! That's our store! Can you smell bread from the chimney?

The alley was a quiet road, one layer removed from the hustle and bustle of the market. A small flower pot on every wall, a bunch of dried wheat on every window. Instead of the smell of money, it smelled like people had lived there for a long time.

This is my neighborhood! The grandmother over there buys us two loaves of bread every morning, and the uncle over there only likes morel bread. Oh, that wall is where I fell when I was five and lost a tooth—
Luna's boast stopped halfway down the alley. The smell of bread, which would normally be wafted into the alley at this time, was absent today.
Luna. Do you usually smell bread this time of year?
Yes, always. They hold their noses from the end of the alley. today…
Luna sniffed. The big ears perked up anxiously. My steps got faster and faster, and then I started running.
At the end of the alley that Luna pointed to was a small, round store. There was no smoke coming from the chimney.
Yeon followed suit and ran. My short legs caught on the gravel and I almost fell twice, but this time it wasn't funny. I feel like the little back running ahead of me keeps breaking down.
Luna's steps slowed down by half a beat.
It's strange. I always bake during this time. My sister doesn't take a day off.
There was a yellow piece of paper attached to the door of the store. It was thick, government-smelling paper with a gold stamp on it.
「If payment is not made within the deadline, the store and all accessories will be recalled. Blue Rabbit Financial Group.”
Sister… ?
Luna pushed open the door and ran in. Instead of the smell of bread, there was the smell of a cold oven.

The inside of the store was stopped after welcoming customers. The bowl containing the dough hardened and cracked, and the chair in front of the oven was pushed back. It was a place where someone was quickly dragged away.
Sister! Where is your sister? I'm here, I've finished delivering!

There was no answer. Instead, on the counter was another piece of yellow paper like the one that had been attached to the door earlier. Blue rabbit stamp. And below that, a line of my sister’s hastily typed handwriting.
「Luna. Dinner is in the refrigerator. Just pay back the interest and I'll be back soon. “Do a good job locking down the door.”
I heard you arrived soon. My sister has never broken a promise. But the oven has cooled down. It's been a few hours.

Luna held the paper tightly. My small shoulders were shaking. The brave delivery rabbit who had memorized the entire island just now was gone, and only the little boy who lost his older sister remained.
I went to pay the interest, but why didn't the person come back? I didn't go there to repay this, I was taken away.
Blue Rabbit Finance does not only use money as collateral. If there is nothing to repay, put the person himself on the ledger. Under the name of ‘debt labor’.
People… As collateral? What nonsense is that—
On the island of Jaeseong, it makes sense. Here, every day that is not repaid is charged to the person who repays.
Yeoni looked down at the bowl of hardened dough. The most delicious bread in the world. Just thinking about where the hands that baked the bread were and what they were doing now gave me a chill.
What should I do? How can I find my sister alone? No one on this island confronts a green rabbit.
Yeoni bent her knees and was at eye level with Luna. With its short paws, it wrapped its trembling hands.
Luna. Look at me. Did you see that I just proved that you are not a thief in that market? We do some of that stuff.
Sister, let's find it together. I'll give it all back to you, not even a single piece. The bread, my sister, and my sister’s face. promise.
Really? The pig... No, is Yeon really going to help you?
It's not a pig, it's a kite. And yes, really. Instead, I reserved the largest bread for my sister later.
Yes! I'll give you even a hundred! If you find my sister, there are 100!
Luna wiped her tears with her sleeve. It wasn't a quick transfer like before, but a small spark returned in the wet eyes. It was the spark that came from knowing that I was not alone.
One more destination. Before finding the entrance to Inseong’s library, head to Blue Rabbit’s headquarters.
But Neo. If the three of us just invade Blue Rabbit's headquarters... Is that through?
Force doesn't work. That is the castle of covenant and scales. To win, you have to be more accurate than them, within their rules.
Win within the rules. Okay, that's not my specialty, it's your specialty. I'm screaming from the side.
That's the division of roles again. Well, it's not bad.
Then what about me? What should I do too? The directions are already the best!
Are you… Our mascot. And the first person to recognize my sister's face. That's the most important role.
Mascot! good! I'll be the cutest mascot in the world!
Outside the window, the pure gold building in the middle of the market burned red in the evening glow. The blue rabbit emblem seemed to be looking down and smiling.
Episode 15 · The smell of gold across the river — the end. Continuing from Episode 16, “The Smell of Burnt Bread.”

episodes.tag: Episode 16 · The smell of burnt bread
episodes.title: The smell of burnt bread

beats.t: The inside of the store was narrow and warm, but somehow I was tired.

The smell of flour and butter permeated the walls. It was a smell that only long-loved kitchens have. But underneath that friendly smell, there was a hint of burnt smell. It wasn't the smell of today's burnt bread, but the smell of a mistake that had been repeated for several days.
There is a withered flower pot by the window. It seemed like there was no time to water it. Looking at the dried leaves, Yeon was able to guess where time stopped in this house.
It's warm, but it smells sad. weird. Even smells have expressions.
The bread on the shelf was neat. But behind the counter was a mountain of paper. Order forms, reminders, calculators, and even scales.

There was a faded picture on the wall. A drawing of two rabbits holding hands, drawn with clumsy crayon. Below, in crooked letters, was written ‘My sister and I at the bakery.’ It looks like Luna drew it when she was young.
This picture is pretty. This store isn't just a bakery, it's a couple's home.
Yeon suddenly felt heartbroken. That paper mountain wasn't just debt. It was the mountain that was eating away the smile in that picture, little by little.

There was a ‘Today’s Bread’ blackboard hanging on one side of the store. Instead of a menu, there was text that had been erased. ‘Enjoy your meal today —’. The afterword was erased. It was a sign of a day when I didn't even have the energy to finish the greeting.
My sister went out to pay the interest and finally returned and was standing in front of the oven. While I was lost, the bread on the tray was completely charred.
Sister! What's the bell on the door? What is recovery?
The woman called sister slowly turned around. The shadow under the eyes was darker than the apron.
Luna. Did you have a good delivery? Oh, there were guests too. Welcome. The bread… Ah, this is burnt.

Luna threw down the basket and jumped into her sister's arms. My older sister patted her small back with her flour-covered hands. It was a familiar touch. I do it every day, and that makes it even more heartbreaking.
Why aren't you smiling? Why are you so thin? I just went out for a day.
It's okay. It's because I've been standing in front of the oven for a long time. Our Luna had a hard time making deliveries, right? My legs hurt.
Yeon-i's heart ached as she saw that. The older sister was the one who was thin, but she worried about her legs first. Love always seemed to start from the side that had it harder.
Customers, what are you doing standing there? Please sit down. I still have the soboro I baked in the morning. I'll eat the burnt one, so eat it healthy.
Thank you. however… She eats whatever is healthy, and the guests usually eat whatever they want while paying attention.
Oh, what an interesting guest. This is my first time seeing a talking flower pig. There's everything special about this island, but it's been a while since I've had a funny customer.

I am originally human. I clicked on a strange app and was dragged into this world and turned into a flower pig. I'm on a trip to the island to retrieve the fortune telling letter. Hard to believe, right? I still can’t believe it either.
I believe it. In this world, people sometimes lose their faces on the scales. A human being turned into a flower pig is rather cute.
It's the third time I heard the word cute today. This body isn't bad either. No, it's bad, but I'm getting used to it.
I recognize one thing: adaptability.
But sister. On such a difficult day, they even gave us bread to see for the first time. Why are you so nice?
It's not a good thing, it's a habit. The harder the days are, the more I want to give something to others. This will confirm that I am still a person who can give something.
Yeon-i got a little choked up at those words. A person who has been deprived of everything seeks something to give to others. The heart was so kind, and that was why it hurt so much.

Yeoni carefully picked up one Soboro with her front paw. Crispy on the outside, moist on the inside. Even though all the hands were gone, the bread they made was still the most delicious in the world.

Yeon-i's nose suddenly felt sore. For the first time on Jaeseong Island, I felt like I had encountered something priceless. The kind of taste that makes the needle not budge even if you put it on a scale.
Sister. This taste, no matter how hard Blue Rabbit tries to retrieve it, he will never be able to take it away. Because it doesn't go on the scale. Because it's already inside me.
Huh? This is really delicious. What Luna boasted wasn't an exaggeration.
Look! I said it was the most delicious thing in the world! Eating my sister’s bread gives me strength!

Luna sat down next to her sister and gently placed half of her share of bread back on her sister's plate. My sister pretended not to see and pushed half of it towards Luna again. The silent scuffle continued for a long time.
As Yeoni watched the scuffle, she tore off her share of bread with her short paws and placed it on Luna's plate. This time, Luna accepted without any fuss, smiling brightly.
Yeon is kind! But why don't you eat it? pig… No, Yeon is hungry too!
I ate rice cake with my eyes at the market earlier. It's eye candy too.
How do you eat with your eyes?
Before coming to this world, I ate with my eyes every day. Looking at your bank account balance. Only people who know that it's really filling know that.

Luna didn't understand everything that was said, but Yeon laughed and she laughed along. Even my thin sister laughed out loud for the first time in a long time. Even with just one cold loaf of bread, the kitchen was warm for a moment.
Yeon thought. Protecting this warmth is as important as recovering a certain fortune-telling letter. Maybe that's Jaeseong's real character.
She looked down at the bread she was burning. It was not the face of the person who burned the bread for the first time today.
(The person who bakes bread so well has burned his bread. That's more than once. His mind is somewhere else, not his hands.)

Sister, you keep burning it these days. In the past, I didn't burn it even with my eyes closed. I can't sleep well at night, and I keep typing away on the calculator. I pretend not to worry because I'm worried, but I know everything.

Luna whispered in a low voice. It was something I said secretly to my sister. The child who seemed like a five-year-old was, at that moment, more adult than anyone else. Recognizing the hardships of a loved one had nothing to do with age.
(These siblings are lying to each other for each other's sake. They both say 'I'm fine'. The lies that the worst people tell the best.)

Yeon-i. That piece of paper behind the counter isn't just a debt reminder. Look. That handwriting, that seal. It all came from one place. This is not a personal debt, but an organized collection operation.
Organized? So you're saying that she didn't do anything particularly wrong, but was a target from the beginning?
That's highly likely. A trap this tight cannot be caught by accident. Someone targeted this store.
Excuse me, I saw the notice on the door. It came from Cheongtoki Financial Group.
It looks like your younger brother is indebted to you. Please sit down first. Even if it’s cold bread, bread is bread.
When I asked her name, my sister just smiled and shook her head. It was said that even the name is collateral on this island. So everyone just called her the bakery sister.

Neo lowered his gaze for a moment at those words. When faced with the story of someone whose name was stolen, he always became a little quiet. It's like someone who knows someone somewhere, who lives with their name erased.
(It's that look again. Neo's eyes change whenever the 'nameless person' is mentioned. I'll have to ask him sometime. Not today, though.)

name can be recovered. If you're just being held as collateral, just break the contract and you'll come back. The problem is, you forget what you took as collateral. If you forget it, you won't even think about getting it back.
That's right. These days, sometimes I can't even tell what my original face looked like. That's what I'm most scared of. It's better to forget what you've lost than to lose it.
Then we will remember. I heard you have the same face as Luna. Then don't forget it. There is a mirror next to you every day.
It's a mirror. Those are pretty words. She is my mirror, and I am her oven.

Honestly. The only thing that will erase me is that I think it will happen now. But there is one thing that is scary. After I'm all erased, Luna... Being completely alone on this island. The only person who can take that child as collateral is me.
Sister.

Luna doesn't know yet. That I am disappearing little by little with interest. If he found out, he would definitely sell his leg to pay for it. Because she's that kind of girl. So, I need to get this contract done before she finds out.

I'll finish it. Don't let Luna ever think it's her fault, cleanly. Sister, I promise you one thing. If we win tomorrow, don't carry it alone from then on. If it's hard, say it's hard. It's really difficult, but you just have to practice. I'll continue to do it next to you.
A strange guest, really. To this extent in someone else’s life. however… thank you. That ‘strangeness’ is so warm tonight.
The candles swayed quietly. The shadows of two people overlapped over the two cups of cold tea. A person who was a stranger and a person who was a stranger were staying up all night together.
Yeon squinted at the mountain of paper behind the counter. The bundle of order forms was strange.
These order forms are all bulk orders? Two hundred loaves of bread, three hundred pies. It's too big compared to the size of the store.
I suddenly received a large order three months ago. Festive delivery, top lunch box, and even sailor biscuits. There was no reason to refuse. No, I didn't think I should refuse.
To receive orders, we need to expand the oven, and to expand the oven, we need money. Then he came. With a very friendly face.
「We will offer you a special interest rate, sir. “For a person with talent, wealth greets him first.”
They said it was a blue-furred rabbit gentleman. He had a smile like gold-rimmed glasses, a two-page contract, and the handwriting was beautiful.

As soon as the gentleman entered the store, he savored each and every bread on the display. Then he closed his eyes as if in admiration. “With this small talk… You seem to be in love with the dough. “The God of Wealth would be disappointed to see such talent buried in an alley.”

In the contract he presented, only the benefits were written in bold, kind letters on the first page. Special interest rates, deferred repayments, and honorary customer treatment. In fact, the collateral clause was hidden in ant-sized letters at the bottom of the second page.
I only read the first chapter. The second chapter was said to be ‘formal, so you don’t have to read it.’ I fell for that one word. In one kind voice.
When it comes to contracts that say 'you don't have to read it', that's usually all there is to it.
It's a complete terms and conditions scroll scam. They put only good words at the top to get people to click 'I agree', and put the truly scary things down below. I really hate that.
That sense will be useful in front of the scale tomorrow. Because you are good at sniffing out ‘hidden clauses’.

That person said that. Boss, bread is the treasure of this island. If you just increase the oven, you can handle both the delivery to the mansion and the palace banquet. I think those words were the first words that recognized my bread.
My sister's voice wavered for a moment. Even though I knew it was a scam, the excitement at that moment seemed real.

We added three ovens. A dough machine and a large refrigerator. We were so busy that we couldn't keep up with orders even if we baked it all night. So much so that Luna can't deliver. That time... I think I was the happiest. Like a fool.

My sister's eyes reflected those days for a moment. Even at three in the morning, smoke rose from the chimney, and the smell of bread filled the alley. Luna ran around the island carrying a delivery bag. “My sister’s bread!” I shouted proudly.

Gold coins piled up. For the first time, I bought Luna a new coat. For the first time, I paid all overdue rent at once. My sister said that at that time, she thought the world was finally on her side.
But one morning, orders stopped coming. In one day. Two hundred yesterday, zero today. At first I thought it was a mistake. But it was zero the next day and the day after that.

The three ovens were empty and cooling down. The ingredients I bought went to Shanghai. And the interest increased accurately every day, regardless of orders. The bills of several happy months had arrived all at once.
That's when I realized. Those big orders were not meant to make me fat, but to inflate me and make me explode. Like a balloon.
I'm not stupid. If someone recognizes your talent, your heart will open. The one who aimed for that is the bad one.
Thank you for saying that. By the way, customer. The scariest thing in the world is when bad people are kind. By the time you realize that kindness is a trap, you've already lost your footing.
But it's strange. After receiving the loan, all large orders were canceled. Without a penny of penalty, it goes away like smoke.

When I looked back at the order form, the address of the ordering party did not exist. Haunted Top, Haunted Mansion, Haunted Banquet. These were orders for which I had no intention of buying bread from the beginning.

Creates demand to fulfill the loan, and erases the demand as soon as the loan is issued. What remains is debt that cannot be repaid and expanded facilities. The equipment is recovered at a low price. The design is detailed.

It's not just us. The noodle restaurant next door and the blacksmith shop across the street all suffered the same. Suddenly, a big order comes, but once you get the loan, it disappears. Everyone now wears chains and works underground.
An entire alley? This isn't a one-person scam, it's a factory that is destroying the entire island.
Yes. Blue Rabbit is not a scammer, it is a system. He's not deceiving any individual, he's slowly moving the entire island into his ledger. Using people as collateral, one by one.
Then it's not a matter of finding one sister. The system itself must be destroyed in front of the scale.

Everyone was smiling when they signed. When you're hungry, you sell your future with a smile. I just put a price on that smile.
Calling a hungry person's signature voluntary is like saying a drowning person 'chose' a straw. That's not a choice, it's a compulsion.
Do your philosophy in front of the scales, watchman. This is not a place to discuss emotions, but a place to manage assets.

Yeoni's whole body was shaking as she looked around the warehouse. It wasn't just because of anger. I thought that somewhere among those gray people, the baker's sister would be standing there soon. That thought made my feet crumble.

And suddenly, Yeon remembered her reality. Student loans that didn't go down no matter how much I repaid, and various fees that took part-time expenses first. The cool feeling that those gray people might be what my future looks like.
Neo. Here, it doesn’t sound like someone else’s story. I could have been like that too. If only I were a little more unlucky.
That's why you can't get past them. Because it's no one else's business. That heart is the most dangerous and precious thing on the island of Jaeseong.

Yeon-i. Isn’t this warehouse strange? Blue Rabbit is a con artist whose only goal is to make money, so he does not sell the images he has collected. Just stacking it up. As if they were collecting it to ‘deliver’ to someone.
delivery? A human face... To whom?

I don't know. But the ‘Chairman’ that Blue Rabbit mentioned earlier. And that pocket watch. Not all of them are from this era. The exploitation of this island seems to be a means to something beyond money. It's ominous.

Yeon looked around the warehouse. Hundreds of workbenches, hundreds of blurred faces. What if all of this isn't just a loan shark, but part of something much bigger and darker? That thought ran down my spine.
Whatever. Let’s start by saving the people who are being erased right before our eyes. The big picture later. Today, my sister and this warehouse. That's enough.
Yes. Always from the bottom of your feet. That's your way. Not bad.
Luna quietly left a loaf of bread in front of Mr. Bread Man's workbench. The man didn't recognize me, but Luna still left it behind. When your memories come back someday, don't be hungry.
It's called the Debt Labor Corps. Everyone signed voluntarily. It's also in very beautiful handwriting.
These people, all of them.
is collateral. The most stable asset on the island of Jaeseong is ultimately yourself. Even if the price of gold and silver fluctuates, despair is always at face value.
Aren't you scared when you only value people like that? Someday you too will step on that scale.
Me? Hehehe. I already went up there a long time ago, sir. So I know. How insignificantly light a person is on that plate.
The blue rabbit's smile changed into something else for a moment, just for a moment. It wasn't a laugh, it was like a long-festering wound.
I was once one of that gray bunch. A nameless back alley rabbit. A handyman who carried scales. I learned it then. In this world, something that has no price is the same as not existing.
Did you get hit too? Then why do you do the same thing to others—
I'm doing it because I was bullied. I learned in that warehouse that it is better to be on the receiving end than on the receiving end. I will never step up to the plate again. Whatever it takes.

Yeon-i was momentarily speechless at those words. He was a person you should hate, but somewhere in those eyes, there was an indelible young rabbit curled up. A child who treats the world only as a price, and who eventually comes to treat the world only as a price.
(It's this smell again. This guy is also 'used' by someone. He pretends to be at the top, but neither that pocket watch nor the energy in those fingernails are mine. Someone gave them to him.)
One workbench was empty. There was no name on the nameplate yet, but there was a reservation ticket attached. "bakery. Tomorrow at noon.”

Preparations were already placed on the workbench. A rag for cleaning gold coins, a scale, and a chain to fasten one's ankles. There was already a small nameplate attached to the end of the chain. 「For storing the image of the debtor.」
Is this my sister's seat? Are you trying to get your sister to sit here? Tomorrow at noon?
Luna held on to the chain with both hands. With his small body, he tried to tear off the heavy chain. So that you can open your hands. But the chain didn't budge.
No! You can’t let my sister sit here! You need to be in front of the oven! Not here! Not here!

As Yeon looked at that empty workbench, she imagined something without realizing it. The older sister in the flour-covered apron, wearing that chain, polishing the gold coins, her face becoming increasingly blurred. Even Luna's name is forgotten.
Just thinking about it was unbearable. Yeon’s short front paws trembled. It wasn't anger, but determination to never let that go through my body.
Yeon-i. calm down. If we break the chain by force here, we will be in violation of the contract. They're after that. You have to win within the rules. Tomorrow, in front of the scale.
I know. I know… Neo, it's really hard to endure even after seeing this place. Tomorrow, I will tear this reservation ticket to shreds in front of the scale.

Yeoni didn't touch the reservation ticket. Instead, I stood in front of it and deeply engraved it in my eyes. "bakery. “Tomorrow at noon.” I will definitely change these six letters to six other letters. "bakery. “Resumption of business.”

Hmm. Those eyes, the price is rising, sir. Anger is good collateral. Because it lasts a long time, rides well, and moves people. Tomorrow, let’s put that anger on the scales. I'll tell you how much it weighs.
Good. Look again. But let me tell you in advance, this anger cannot be measured on your scales. Because it's not my weight, it's the weight of all those people. Your scale might break tomorrow.

For the first time, the blue rabbit did not laugh. Pure gold eyes stared at Yeon for a long time. I had a premonition that that little flower pig might really destroy the scales I had built up over 30 years. For the first time, that premonition cracked his perfect smile.
I saw it, Cheong. There are some things that cannot be measured in price. Tomorrow, you will see it in person on the scale. Be prepared.

Three people and a child turned their backs to the warehouse. Behind their backs, hundreds of blurry faces saw them off. Without a sound. But in that silence, something bloomed for the first time in a very long time. A very small spark called expectation.
Clean that spot right now.
Oh, those are nice eyes. That kind of anger is expensive, sir. He's good at attracting people.
Let's get to the point. Since it is a fraudulent contract, it is invalid. It is judged according to the laws of this island in front of the scale.
The blue rabbit's ears slowly stood upright this time. He had the face of a child who had discovered a fun toy.

In front of the scale, follow the laws of this island. great. very good. Actually, I've been a bit bored these days. Because it’s so obvious that I’ll win. It's been a while since I welcomed a fearless guest like you. It's nice to meet you.
Blue Rabbit slowly stood up from his seat. Although it was a small body, the entire room seemed to tilt along with its movements. The owner of the scale was finally ready to open the plate.
Good. Tomorrow at noon, in front of the scale. If you win, the contract is void. If indicated.
We will also write down the customer's image neatly in our ledger.

Good. I'll accept it. Instead, there is one condition. If we win, not only will the bakery woman's contract be invalidated, but all of the warehouse people's contracts down there will also be put back on the scale. If even one thing is concluded through deception, it's like dominoes.
Ho-oh. You're raising the bar, sir. I thought you were just here to save a bakery, but you're targeting the entire warehouse.
A precedent starts with one thing and then shakes everything up. You would know best. Because one contract swallowed up the entire island.

Good. I accept that condition. Because you won't win anyway. On the contrary, the bigger the game, the more images you can retrieve when you lose, which is beneficial to me. One watchman, one flower pig, and one delivery rabbit. Oh, all three must be quite expensive.
I'm not selling my money! I'm mine!
Hehe. That spirit is also worth it, young lady. The intention not to sell is the most expensive. Noon tomorrow. See you in front of the scale. Don't be late. Even tardiness accrues interest.
The elevator went up again. Contrary to before, the scale went from ‘debt’ to ‘wealth’. But no one felt lighter. The faces I saw underground were hanging like chains around my ankles.

Indeed, customers. Tomorrow at noon, someone other than me will be in front of the scale. Our chairman showed special interest. Especially to the watchman. Look forward to it. Because you're coming with some really interesting stuff.
Chairman
. That name is the second one today. Who the hell is this?
I don't know. I don't know his face very well either. He only comes on black rainy days and is holding a very old item. He gave one to me too. This pocket watch.

Blue Rabbit took out an old pocket watch from his arms and shook it. A black case that looks like it was carved out of the night sky, not gold or silver. There was a thread engraved on the lid. Neo's eyes froze at that moment.
That watch. Where did you get it? That's not from this era.
Oh, you know it, right? Then I will look forward to tomorrow even more. Okay, you've come up now. Please proceed carefully. Until tomorrow, please take good care of the image.
The golden door closed. From behind, the sound of gold coins rolling followed for a long time. As if they were already pricing three.
On the way back, Luna was silent the entire time, but said one word at the end of the alley.
Your face is really pretty. I mean, it looks just like me. You're definitely going to give it back, right?
Yes. I'll give it all back to you, not even a single piece. promise.

Luna lowered her head instead of answering. The fact that the man who was a regular at the morel bread store earlier didn't recognize him was still stuck in his heart. The person I love forgets me. Today she learned for the first time that there is nothing as scary as that.
Yeon-i. What if my sister forgets me? Just like the guy with morel bread, if you don't recognize me even if you put it in front of me. me… Then I'm really alone.
Luna sat down in front of a small puddle in the alley and cried. Tears fell into a puddle. But something strange happened.
The puddle where the tears touched began to glow very faintly. The waves rippled in sync with Luna's cries. As if the water was crying along with the child's sadness.
Luna. Look, look. The water cries with you. you are not alone The water is on your side, I’m on your side, Neo too… I'm blunt, but I'm on your side.
I will not deny it.
The water shines. Why does it shine? I'm scared, why are you pretty?
Even sadness can be pretty. Especially the sadness of crying because you really love someone. Luna, don't forget that feeling. That will become your strength someday. Somehow, I think so.

Luna wiped her tears and looked into the puddle for a long time. My face reflected in the water was not blurred at all, unlike in the headquarters lobby earlier. It was clear. It seemed that my love couldn't be erased even by a scale.

That night, the three gathered again at the bakery and made the final preparations. Neo reviewed the evidence again, Yeon chose what to say in front of the scale, and Luna… I walked around the alley one more time, holding the hands of people who would become witnesses tomorrow.

Yeon-i. Tomorrow the scale will tip twice. The first is as evidence. Thirty-seven cases of false orders. I am in charge of this. The second is with the heart. If the islanders in the audience feel ‘this is unfair,’ the scale reads the weight. That's your part.
The weight of the heart. But Neo, I’m actually worried. What if those people all shut up because they are afraid of the green rabbit? What if no witnesses come forward?
It could be so. But if just one person has courage, the rest will follow suit. Fear is contagious, but so is courage. The question is, who is the first person?
I'll be the first one. I'm usually good at yelling without hesitation. Tomorrow, in front of the scale, I will be the one who screams the loudest.
My sister brought out freshly baked bread at night. This time I didn't ride at all. Even with half of my hands missing, I kept my spirits up this night and baked bread.
I don't know if tomorrow will be the day I get my face back or the day I lose it completely. But either way, it's really warm tonight. Thank you so much for making this night.
It's the day of taking it back. There's nothing else to say. Come on, sister, get some sleep now. If you want to get your face back tomorrow, you have to sleep well with that face today.

Luna fell asleep on her sister's lap. Even in her sleep, she was holding on to her sister's sleeve tightly. I was even holding on to my sleeping hand because I was afraid it would disappear if I let it go.

Yeon looked at the siblings for a long time. And I quietly made a promise. Tomorrow, when that sleeping hand opens its eyes in the morning, I hope the world will be a little less scary. To do that, I had to win. Whatever it takes.

It's tomorrow. That blue rabbit, the ‘Chairman’ name above it or something. I won't forget any of the faces I saw in the warehouse today. I will properly value those faces in front of the scale. With a value that is priceless.
The night was deep outside the window. On the side of the scale square, a huge scale sparkled silver in the moonlight. Tomorrow at noon, two truths will weigh in on that plate.
Episode 17 · Blue Rabbit Financial Group — The end. Continued from Episode 18, “When the Pocket Watch Is Open.”
