episodes.title: All pillars in place

beats.t: I embraced my shadow on the Mirror Island, regained my voice on the Festival Island, and walked up the Mountain of Riches as a world of value. All those steps had piled up here today, pushing the century-old predator for the first time. Then the cornered beast pulled out its last tooth.
It can't be like this. I, the blue rabbit of this talent, can barely stand up to these idiots. no. There is still one card left. The chairman’s most prized asset. The last pillar of that flower pig.
Yeoni, be careful! Blue Rabbit heads towards Shinmiham! They're after something!
must be stopped! If you force open that box, the pillars inside may explode! Watchman, stop him!
But the blue rabbit had already stretched out his hand with excitement. The sealed box was forcibly opened, and black chains came out. It was the last and meanest move of the cornered beast.
No! That's my last star! If you burn it—!

Yes. Your last star. If you burn this, you will forever be unfinished. Burn the vessels that cannot be collected, that is the chairman's policy. Even if I lose, I have to follow the rules. Just you, no one else can!
! no! That's—
Good. Courtesy ends here. Special collateral No. 1, early disposition begins!
The black velvet box was forcibly opened. The two letters Shinmi were wrapped around a chain and dragged out into the air. And the color began to fade from Yeon’s body.
Huh? I can't see the front paws. Not the hand, but the foot disappears. What is this, I… Am I being erased?!

You understand quickly. That Shinmi, your last pillar and the Chairman's asset. I can't let you take it back. So let's burn it. No one can have it. Then you will disappear forever, unfinished, and the Chairman can use this time for other things.
Contract Article 9. If the collateral is lost, the debtor's character is treated as unredeemed. No returns, no refunds, no existence. That's a very neat clause.

Yeon's outline became gray and blurred. Just like those people in the cellar, or even faster than that. As the two letters Shinmi burned into the chain, Yeoni's very existence was being erased from the world.
Yeoni! no! Don't disappear! You just said you can go back to being human! I just won everything! Why, why again—!
It's incineration! That thief is trying to burn Shinmi itself! If the pillar burns down, Yeon will disappear forever, unfinished! Yeon! Hold on! Don't let go of your sentence!
Yeoni!
Neo rushed at him, but the sword did not work because the chains were made to be reworked. Even the rereading of the hundred sentences could not keep up with the speed of incineration.
Yeoni! no! Don't disappear! my water! If you wash with my water—!

Luna tried to wash Yeon by squeezing out the remaining water, but incineration was not pollution but 'erasure of existence'. It wasn't even washed with water. Luna's water stream passed right through Yeon's blurring body.
No. Not washed. Yeon-i, Yeon-i disappears. Like my sister during the trial… Am I losing someone precious before my eyes again?! no!
Yeoni! Come to your senses! That chain is caught because your order is incomplete! Because your last pillar is not yours yet! Please, hold on! Should I use my strength?! If you use that gold now—

Watchman, no! If you use that power now, ‘that woman’ will appear here! Then it's over for Yeon and us! Yeon! You have to do it yourself! Your sentence! Recall that sentence engraved in the reading room!
My sentence Why do I fight... that's right. I didn't come here to disappear. I'm here to get it back. my last star Neo, don't exert yourself. I do this.
In her blurred vision, Yeon-i was strangely calm. My body turned gray, but my mind was clearer than ever. As if everything I learned in the library was just for this last moment.
It's not scary. Amazingly. Even though my body is erased. Baekmoon said that. They say a watch can't do anything if it doesn't shake. Right now, I’m not shaken at all. Because I know who I am.

The white room in the reading room came to mind. I remembered the sentence I had pressed down with my own hand. “To read my destiny with my own hands and protect the names around me with my own writing.”
This sentence is my root. If I hold on to this, no amount of incineration can erase me. Because I am the owner of my story. It's not Green Rabbit's collateral.
Yes. I am the owner of that sentence. And the original is stronger than the copy.
At that time, Yeon's blurred body sparkled like a mirror. Inside, a familiar face was looking this way.
It was Yeon in the mirror. This time, it wasn't a flower pig, but a human being. Yeon-i's alter ego, whom we first met on the Island of Cowardice.

you. me in the mirror How did you get here… ? I'm being erased right now.
You called
, right? No, more accurately, you finally read me.
You were my human side from the beginning. It wasn't lost, it was waiting here.
Yes. I couldn't go out of the mirror while your order was unfinished. But now you are the owner of the three pillars and the owner of your emblem.
You've been waiting for me here. The day I become whole. The day I get myself back. Sorry. All this time, I just thought of you as a ‘lost human being.’ You weren't lost, you were waiting for me.

Yes. But I don’t blame you. I saw you cross three islands as a pig, I saw it all from here. I was proud. I thought I was that kid. And you know what? When you were a flower pig, you were more human than when you were a human. Because after losing my appearance, I found the real you.

That's right. With this flower-pig body, I learned the meaning, not the price. How to look at the heart, not the face. So even if I go back to being a human, I won't forget this lesson. Eyes that look inward, not outward.

That's enough. That's the real treasure you gained on this journey. Now, let's become one. The flower pig Yeon and the human Yeon. Me who knows the price, and you who know the meaning. Then you become a truly perfect Yeon.
But you're not disappearing, are you? Becoming one doesn't mean you disappear, it means you come into me, right?

Yes. It won't disappear. I will always be inside you. A mirror that says back to you when you falter, ‘No, you’re like this.’ When you are swayed by the price, a voice whispers, ‘Look at the meaning, not the price.’ I become a part of you. It's not about losing, it's about combining.

Thank goodness. I was sad for a moment because I thought I was losing you. Yes, let's become one. With a perfect love that knows the value and the meaning. Neither the green rabbit's incineration nor the woman's watch, but Yeon-yi, who cannot be shaken.

Okay. Hold out your hand. The last line, let’s write it together. The last stroke of your fortune, the end of Shinmi. 'This person is himself from beginning to end.' This is a sentence that completes four eight letters.
'This person is himself from beginning to end.' … huh. This is me. Not anyone's collateral or anyone's asset. Just me. Yeon.

Yeon, the person in the mirror, held out her hand. From his fingertips, the light of Shinmi, the last lost star, gently flowed. The moment the two kites were about to merge into one, the gray light of the fire stopped for a moment. The clock's power to erase existence was powerless in front of the one who read itself completely.
That last line, should we write it together?
Now, write this sentence to the world with me. On the gray light of incineration, with the confidence of both of us. Are you ready?
Yes. I'm ready. I am me. It's not Blue Rabbit's collateral or the Chairman's assets. I am the owner of my story.

Yeoni extended her hand to herself in the mirror. A person's hand touched the glassless mirror surface. It was the moment when Yeon, who knew the value, and Yeon, who knew the meaning, finally became one.

The two successions overlapped and became one dazzling light. In that light, the gray light of the fire was completely pushed away and the star of Shinmi found its place and shined. Value and meaning, the flower pig and the human, the frightened child and the upright child — were finally integrated into one complete series.

When the two hands touched, Yeon-i's body, which had turned gray, began to regain its color. The power of incineration flowed back in front of those who faced it completely. ‘Erasure of existence’ could not overcome ‘certainty of existence’.

I am a kite. Yeon is a flower pig and Yeon is a human. Know the value, know the meaning. Reclaim seven of the eight letters, and retrieve the last one now. Blue Rabbit, you can’t erase me with your chains. I totally know who I am now.

At that moment, Shinmi, who was wrapped in chains, cried herself. Iron God (辛) is originally the character of a jewel that shines at the end of forging. It wasn't a letter that would be wrapped around a fake chain or something. It glowed dazzlingly within the chain, as if answering its master's call.
takes root. To the end of my name!
The vine roots dug under the chain clause and pulled up the original text. “The owner of this pillar is Yeon from beginning to end.”
No! That collateral is the chairman’s property! If you take it back, there will be a hole in the time the Chairman has saved for a hundred years—!

It was originally mine. That woman stole it. Taking back is not theft; it is taking back what was stolen. Blue Rabbit, your chain has ‘Pawn’ written on it, but the original says ‘Yeon’s’. A copy can't beat the original.

The chain broke like glass. Shinmi, who had been trapped in the Chairman's seal for a hundred years, has finally returned to her owner. Shinmi seeped into Yeoni's chest, and the fourth pillar was inserted into the last position. The eight letters became complete for the first time.

As Shinmi found her seat, Yeon-i's body, which had been erased to gray, began to regain its color. The incineration stopped and revival began. The eight perfected letters firmly anchored Yeon’s existence to the world.

Light enveloped the body. The pig's round body gradually relaxed, its shortened arms returned to length, and ten fingers sprouted from the tips of its stubby hooves. It was the moment when the human body lost on Jaeseong Island finally returned.
Human Yeon stood where the light disappeared. Just like when I first fell into this world, only with a straighter back than before. Eight stars, now a full constellation, shone in my heart.
I went there, I.

Yeoni looked down at her hands for the first time in a long time. Ten fingers. human hand. The human body I longed for so much. But strangely enough, the reason I cried wasn't because of the hand I got back, but because of the faces of those who came here with me.

Yeon? that is… Is it you? Human kite? Wow, you look like this. He was cute even when he was a flower pig, but he was also pretty when he was a human. But for some reason, I feel like I'm missing the flower pig, Yeon. lol.
Luna. Even if I become human, nothing will change between you and me. Whether it's a flower pig or a person, I'm just a kite. Yeon will protect you. don't cry. I'm not going anywhere.

Yeon-i. Finally, you're back. When I first met you, you were a scared person. And then I became a scared little pig. But now you... A person who is not afraid. Stand with a straight back. We've come so far, we.

Neo. It's all thanks to you. I came this far because you protected me from the front and side. I can go home soon. But it's strange. I'm happy, but I'm already sad thinking about breaking up with you guys.

Heh heh. What a feeling it is to see a disciple who has become perfect. I never thought that in a hundred years, this old man would be so proud. Yeon. You have now filled out all eight letters. You have earned the right to return home. But before that—

Yes. Before that, from that blue rabbit. And bring back all of this mountain range, Luna's face, wish, and Baekmun's librarian's signature. After I get everything back, I'll go home then. Now, let's really wrap it up.

Yeon closed her eyes for a moment and looked inside herself. Eight stars formed a complete constellation. Eulhae, Imo, and now Shinmi. A life that was half a beat out of sync, finally got into sync. I felt like the world became clearer.
It's fascinating. I only filled in one last star, but the world is so clear. and… I am so confident in myself. In the past, I always felt like I was half-hearted. I am now the whole person.

That's the completed fortune telling. The eight letters support each other, so you will not be shaken. Now you are no longer a half-hearted person who only protects others, but a full person who knows how to protect yourself as well. Didn’t Moka tell you to ‘sing your song too’? You can sing now.

That's right. Now, I feel like I can protect others and not lose myself. But Baekmun. Now that I have become whole, I know more clearly. This strength I regained, I didn't get it to live well alone. I got it so I could save others.

Huh. You realize that as soon as you become whole. Are you really… I was born with character. Now, just like that. Let's save this mountain range and stop that thief. Hundred-year-old sincerities are waiting for your brush.

Yeon-i. Seeing you become whole, I feel touched as well. When I first met you, you were the girl who cried for three days because you lost your face. Now, he is determined to fill his zodiac sign and save others as well. Really, we've come a long way.
We all came together. I didn't come alone. Neo, Baekmoon, Luna, Moka... And I want to get my sister and Somangi back. We all came here together. Now, let's really wrap it up. With our own hands.
Yes. Seeing you intact gives me strength too. Now, let's get this library back and stop the blue rabbit. Everything I learned in the library, I am proving it here and now.
Me too! I'm not a burden anymore! Luna, the water delivery rabbit, fights until the end! Until you get your face back!

Yeon-i, who became human, adjusted her pen and held it. Ten fingers perfectly wrapped around the brush. With the pig's hoof, he could only draw one line, but now he could draw ten lines at once. The perfect power resides in the hands of a perfect person.
Now, let's begin! All the hundred-year-old truths in this library, wake up! Today is the day to reclaim your real name!

Yeoni’s brush split the air. A hundred years of writing were written on the tip of the brush. The black seals in the library all began to tremble at that single stroke. The final rewrite that would destroy the empire of value was beginning.
collateral price… You signed a contract on your own?!

Yeon squeezed and unclenched her hand once. And they stood side by side next to Neo, Baekmoon, and Luna. Four breaths uttered in complete harmony for the first time. Iron, wood, water, and a hundred years of history. It was a battle of meaning against the world of values.
Blue Rabbit. Until now, we had only defended ourselves. But not anymore. I became whole, Baekmun came, and Luna also awakened. Now it's our turn to attack. Everyone, let’s go until the end!

Prevent escape with gold wire. In this library, seal all the holes through which the green rabbit can escape. Yeon restores the mountain range, Luna washes away the pollution, and Baekmoon holds on to the clock. let's go!
This is the moment I've waited a hundred years for! All of you who have been trampled by this thief, rise up together! Let's get your real names back today!
I'm ready too! Down to the last drop of water! I won't stop until I get my sister's face back!
gold wire. Escape route blocked.
Reread all the original texts in the library at once!

The document mountain range stood up with white light. When the strength of Yeon-i and Baek-moon, who had become whole, came together, the weight that had been broken alone was lifted in four. Thousands of people read my sentences out loud all at once. “For tuition,” “for medicine,” “to survive the winter.” The gold that had been rewritten was washed away by the chorus.
Can you hear me, Baekmun?! These guys are taking my name back! The gray people above are probably turning back into humans at this very moment!
Yes! This is the sight I have dreamed of for a hundred years! I couldn't do it alone. But with you here, this whole mountain range awakens at once! Keep going, Yeon! Until the end!

The black seals of the mountain range washed down like a waterfall. “Incompetent” became “mother,” “incompetent person” became “person who liked singing,” and “recoverable target” became “father of three children.” The sincerity that had been oppressed for a hundred years regained its name all at once. The foundation of the Blue Rabbit Empire was collapsing.

From the revived originals, small lights resembling the library's lantern fish bloomed one by one. It was the light that was born from the suppressed sincerity breathing again. The lights circled around the kite like stars, greeting it silently. Thank you. After a hundred years, for reading me as myself.

Hey guys. No one can erase your real name now. Your bodies above are probably returning from gray to human form right now. Go and meet your family. If there's anything I can't say, I say it. Live with your heart, not with prices. That's your real life.

Lights soared upward through the ceiling. They returned to their respective bodies and to their respective families. At this moment, the gray people who pushed the scales in Jaeseong's underground workplace were regaining their color one by one and regaining their names. It was a miracle that Yeon-i and Baek-moon achieved together.

One hundred years. I want to see that light again. Alone, I could barely clean one shelf, but with you, the entire mountain range awakens at once. Yeon. Thank you. You made this old man’s wish of 100 years come true in one day.

Because Baekmun has protected us for a hundred years. Because Baekmoon did not abandon these sincerities and kept them, I was able to revive them today. We achieved this together. Baekmoon’s years and my brush.
Wow… The entire library glows white. All the black stuff is washed away. Yeon and Baekmoon are saving all these people! I'll help too! Last water!

The last water that Luna squeezed out sprinkled over the mountain range, washing the revived texts and making them sparkle. The iron blocked the way, the wood established the truth, and the water made it shine. And at the center of it all, there was Yeon-i, who had become whole.
And, um.
The first wooden meal taken out by human hands was of a different quality from that of a pig's hoof. Sprouts sprouted all over the floor of the library, turning the black hands into flowers.
This is full power! Since you hold the brush with ten fingers, your writing is ten times clearer! All the black hands have become flowers!

Yeoni's brush, now intact, roamed the length and breadth of the library. Yeon, who had barely been able to rewrite one line with a pig's hoof, was now rewriting ten lines at once with a human hand. The black library turned into a flower garden wherever he passed.

Beautiful. The seals that have dyed this library black for a hundred years have bloomed into flowers with a single stroke of your brush. This is the perfection of rewriting. Not erasing, but reviving. Yeon, you have surpassed me now. Sincerely.

No, Baekmun. Because Baekmoon has protected these sincerities for 100 years, I can revive them today. If Baekmoon wasn’t there, all these sincerity would have been extinguished a long time ago. This is a brush for both of us.
Put my water on both of your brushes! Look, I'm washing all the revived originals and making them sparkle! The three of us... No, it's a collaboration between the four!

Yes. It's a collaboration between the four. Block the road with a gold wire, establish truth with a brush, shine it with water, and a hundred years of history divide the roots. This is our team. Blue Rabbit alone can never win.
Yeon-i! Flowers bloom throughout the stand! It's so pretty! The vault of value has become a flower garden! Blue Rabbit Look at me, I’m completely confused!
It can't be like this! My library! My black hands! My wealth, accumulated over a hundred years, can only be found in a few sprouts!
Not just a few sprouts. I'm serious about the hundred years you trampled on. Now, that sincerity is blooming as a flower under your feet. Blue Rabbit, your empire of value ends here.

The four people began the final joint effort. Neo's gold wire blocked the blue rabbit's escape route like a net, Baekmun completely tied up his pocket watch with a lantern fish, and Luna washed away the pollution from under his feet with the last water. And in the middle of it all, Yeon picked up the pencil.
You are not the real owner of this library. These are sincere people trapped here. Vines bound!

Yeon-i's blue-green vines stretched out towards the blue rabbit. However, it was not a binding vine, but the sincerity of the revived originals became a flower vine and wrapped around the blue rabbit. The hearts he had trampled on for a hundred years now held him.
Let go! These flower vines, let go! Why, why do the things I trample hold on to me! Why don't you kill me and just hold me—!

They won't kill you. Jinsim doesn’t take revenge. I'm just holding you back so you can't run away anymore. Look straight at what you did. Blue Rabbit, see today what you have trampled on for a hundred years.

The blue rabbit swung its last claw. However, its claws got caught in the gold wire, entangled in the flower vines, and deaf to the chorus of its original meaning, it only drew in the air. The claws of Jaeseong, which had been forged for a hundred years, were powerless in front of the revived sincerity.
Slaughter.
The frost of platinum froze the turbid energy of Jaeseong to the roots. The pocket watch slipped from my hand and fell to the floor. Click, the lid closed on my own.

At the same time, Yeon's rewriting reached its peak. The black seal on the entire library was washed away at once, and the sincerity that had been trapped for a hundred years became pillars of light and soared upward through the ceiling. To the gray people above, to give back the name that has been reclaimed.
It's over. These mountains have all been brought back to life. Blue Rabbit, your price empire has collapsed. The truth that you trampled on for a hundred years is now returning to its original place.

The last black hand collapsed helplessly at the blue rabbit's feet. The red hunting light that illuminated the library went out, filled only with the white light of revived sincerity. It was a complete defeat for the predator who had reigned for a hundred years.

The blue rabbit sat down on a pile of collapsed documents. The cloak was torn, the politeness was removed, and what remained was a rabbit with hungry eyes. The blue rabbit of Jaeseong, who had reigned for a hundred years, was now just a tired and lonely animal.
Yeoni slowly approached the blue rabbit caught in the flower vine. The others were wary, but Yeon-i looked straight into his eyes. And there, before the joy of victory, I read deep sorrow.
Yeon, it’s dangerous. That's a blue rabbit. They took my sister. Don't go near me.
It's okay, Luna. It's not dangerous anymore. I lost all my strength. But I can't get past these rabbit eyes. I won, but I'm not relieved at all. rather… sad.

One day, the cat placed a leaf in front of Yeon. Yeon-i, who was wondering what this meant, suddenly burst into laughter. A heart shape had been very clumsily drawn with its claws on the fallen leaves.
What is this, heart?! Neo?! Oh, really. You pretend to be blunt, but do this again. thank you. Me too, I like you too. Watchmen, cats, everything.

The cat hid under the bench as if it had been caught. The tips of my ears were bright red. Yeon carefully placed the fallen leaves between her books. It was the clumsiest and most sincere heart in the world, conveyed across two worlds.

One night, the mailbox tree bloomed something special. It wasn't a letter, it was a moving picture. It was a kind of video letter in which everyone in Jaeseong waved their hands together across the screen.

The baker held up freshly baked bread, Luna made a fish, Baekmun carved a blessing with his staff, Moka sang a cheering song, and the recovered islanders said, “Yeon! “I’m doing well!” he shouted. And in the far corner, a silver lion stood awkwardly, slightly raising its front paw.

What is this? Everyone. Even video letters. Ah, I'm crying. Everyone like this. Neo, you also lifted your front foot in that corner. Haha, it's still awkward. But everyone, I really want to see you. Not on screen, really.

Wait, everyone. I'll be there soon. It's almost ready. I began to read the meaning of the stars, my wishes were located, and my strength became clear. When she calls, I'll run right away. And this time, I will protect everyone. Without losing a single person.

Yeon watched the video letter again and again. I believe that those smiles will become a light that will protect me in the coming darkness. But at the end of the video letter, just for a moment - the screen crackled black and black stars passed by. The palace of stars was even peeking at that warm letter.
It was one of those nights. The dream became strange.

It rained in my dream. It was black rain. The rain makes your heart wet even if you use an umbrella. It was the same rain that drenched outside the window of Seo Han-bi’s room. And a man with his face obscured by the rain was standing and looking this way.

The man looked sad. It was unfamiliar yet eerily familiar. When Yeon stretched out her hand, the man always scattered through the rain. Every time that happened, the shape of the man's mouth seemed to say something. There was no sound, but it was a very sweet and sad word.

The dream became a little clearer every time. One night, a young girl stood next to a man in the rain. The girl I saw in Shinmiham, looking pale and sick. The man could not bear to let go of the child's hand. Just like a person who never wants to lose that one child in the world.

Another night, the shadow of a silver lion appeared behind the man. The faceless man and the silver lion overlapped and fell. As if it had been one and then split into two. In front of that scene, Yeon shed tears for no reason.
z
Another night, the man in the rain made a sound for the first time. It was very distant and blurry, but it was clearly saying this. 「… Sorry. I dragged you into this world. To protect you, rather.”
(You dragged me into this world? That man? So I came to this world not by chance, but because of that man? Who is that man? What does he have to do with me? Why did he try to protect me?)

The dream gave no answer. They just threw one more piece at a time. A faceless man, a pale child, a silver lion, and the words 'to protect you'. Every time Yeon woke up, she felt that the pieces were coming together toward one painful truth. In the palace of stars, the truth was waiting.
z

Yeoni asked Baekmoon about that dream through the mailbox. “A faceless man in the black rain, a pale child next to him. I keep saying sorry. “What kind of dream is this?” Baekmun’s reply came only after a long pause.

[White Text] It is a memory of the time you lost, a dream wandering around its edges. The faceless man... You are the abandoned half of the person who was trying to protect you. The silver lion and the man are actually one. It just looks like two. I can't say any more. The man's name is intertwined with the truth of the Watchman.

It's intertwined with Neo. also. When I stood next to that man in my dream, I kept seeing Neo over and over again. Baekmoon, what is the relationship between that man and Neo? Why do I feel sorry for that man?

[white text] … It must be heard in the palace of the stars, from the mouth of the watchman. Librarians don’t read other people’s unfinished manuscripts in advance. Just this — if the dream keeps becoming clearer, it means you are getting closer to the truth. Be strong in your heart.
Yes. all right. It's scary, but it doesn't run away. Whatever the truth is, I will face it. But Baekmun. Just one. Is that guy alive now?

[white text] … Well, I don't know. It disappeared a hundred years ago. However, the fact that it keeps appearing in your dreams probably means that there is a trace left somewhere. In the palace of stars, perhaps you will find the answer.

Yeon looked at the reply for a long time. A faceless man, a pale child, and Neo. Little by little, the pieces were coming together toward one picture. It was still blurry, but on the day the picture was completed, Yeon-i's journey would face the most painful truth.

Apart from the heavy dream, the daytime routine continued to flow. And in that daily life, there was now one fixed place. Living room window frame. It was a white cat with amber eyes that would sneak in when the door was open and take the best spot on the desk.

It was a few days ago that the cat, which used to only step on benches and the roof of the convenience store, entered the room. When Yeon-i did her homework, he lay down on his stomach on the laptop keyboard, and only when Yeon-i sighed did he move to the side. It was just half a step.

Watchman. If you sleep on someone else's keyboard, who will do your homework? … No, just stay there. Anyway, not a single line was written today. It feels like the room isn't empty when you're there, and I like that.

Instead of answering, the cat slowly closed and opened one eye. If it were Jaeseong, it was a place where he would have said “Hmph” and turned his back. Only after he became this small body, losing all his strength and dignity, was he finally able to give such an answer.

The infiltration was discovered a long time ago. The operation was already completed the day the contract terms were scribbled with the front foot. However, the cat acted like a fool every time, and Yeon-i pretended to be deceived every time. Neither the one who was caught nor the one who knew didn't bother to remove the foolishness.

Because there were things I had to ask the moment I took it away. How long can it last? How long can this small body endure? When will the door notice him? Both saved the question. An evening where no questions were asked was still more precious.

Whenever Yeon opened the triangle kimbap, the cat meowed and demanded a share. When I gave him a small piece of tuna mayo, he smelled it proudly and eventually ate it all. Then he played it off again.

Acting friendly only in front of food. It's really you. Hey, please answer this anyway. Is everyone okay over there? What about Luna? What about Baekmoon? No news about Somang? … Ha, what am I asking the cat again?

The cat looked up at the night sky outside the window. It was an unusually cloudy night with only one star. A loneliness flashed through those amber eyes, as if he was drawing his own lost constellations. Yeon will remember those eyes for a long time.
Lunch time, bench. The mailbox app rang. It was Luna. This time, not a chat, but a photo. It was a photo of a small water droplet floating in a circle against gravity on top of water in a glass cup.

[Luna] Sister!! I finally succeeded!! Floating water droplets!! As my sister taught me, I kept repeating, ‘Don’t press it, just let it flow’, and it really did float!! Sister, sister, I think I'm talented hehe

Luna. You have really grown up a lot. The girl who used to wash her seal with tears at Jaeseong is now letting water droplets float through her fingertips. You can't force water. You knew it with your own body. If the water of the voiceless is the water that is forced to be confined, then your water is the water that is allowed to flow. That's much older.

[Luna] Hehe, my sister praised me. I should write it down in my diary today. But sister, it seems like the water keeps talking to me these days. The sound of rain sounds sad. It seems like the river is in pain. Is this just a feeling?

(It's not your fault, Luna. The river is really suffering. You've become a child who can hear the sound of water now, so that's what you can hear.) … Yeah, it's probably because of my mood. Still, listen carefully to what the water says. Someday, it will protect you.

Yeoni added one more training at the end of her reply. “This time, practice ‘protecting’ the water droplets. The water droplets floating on the cup will not scatter even if someone taps them. Flow but not collapse. That’s the beginning of the shield.”

[Luna] Shield… ! Oh something cool. I understand, sister. I will practice hard. When my sister comes over there, I'll show her to her. Come quickly, sister. Everyone wait for your sister. Especially me.
Yes. I'll be there soon. Sooner than you think.
Other news also arrived in the mailbox. It was Luna's greetings. After I recovered from my illness, my sister's messages always seemed to smell like freshly baked bread.

[Unnie Luna] Student Yeon, how are you? Luna has been playing with water more these days. No, I didn't call it water play, I called it 'water lily'. It's a big problem because the kitchen floor is always wet... Still, this is the first time I’ve seen our Luna be so sincere about something. It's all thanks to student Yeon.

[Sister Luna] The world over there seems to be a bit turbulent these days. Everyone says the color of the night sky is strange. Student Yeon, don’t overdo it. But if you come, make sure to eat a good meal before coming. You don't fight fate on an empty stomach. My sister will bake a lot of bread for you.
Luna is still the same. I told you to eat first before fighting fate. But strangely enough, those words are the most reassuring. I understand, sister. If I go, I will eat your bread first. Ten.

[Mocha] Teacher Meow, I am Mocha! Jaesung’s stage sales are huge these days! But these days, audiences keep feeling anxious while looking at the sky. They say the stars are strange. I'm a very perceptive person, but something big is coming. Yeon, are you ready? I'll join too. I take over the stage.
Mocha to you. Okay, let’s all prepare together. I won't fight alone this time. You all have it.
That night. Yeon took out a paper fish from her pocket. Somangi’s original. Baekmun's lost daughter. In other words, I might have a clue as to where that child is now. Yeon picked up her pencil.
Somang. I'm not criticizing you. To find you, I'll just read one line. Where are you scared now? I will definitely take you to Baekmun.
A blue-green fish swam out from the tip of the pen and drew a line in the air. 「… Palace of stars, highest tower. In the midst of pale light. “I’m trying not to cry.” And the fish slowly dispersed.

Palace of stars, the highest tower. In the middle of pale light? Then Somangi, the pale fate that she destroyed and imprisoned… Are you in the same place? Overlapping? Could it be that Seo Han-bi left Somang in the same fate as her? why?

Yeon-i got goosebumps. Somangi is Baekmun’s daughter and the most gentle story in the world. But that gentle story overlapped in the same light with the pale fate that Seo Han-bi had destroyed and imprisoned. It's as if the two were originally one body but were forcibly separated. No, was he hoping that a gentle story would hold on to that withering fate a little longer? Either way, it was a strangely creepy place. For some reason, Yeon kept feeling like that overlapping light was her own.

It's that girl again. Just choose things that are too twisted to hate. A collector who displays even benign stories next to the imprisoned fate. Baekmoon, please wait a little longer. Somang has been established. The top of the Palace of Stars. I'll go and get it for sure.

The next day, noon. In the classroom, Yeon suddenly found herself reading the expressions of the classmate sitting next to her. That kid is smiling now, but his eyes are crying. Something happened last night. The 'reading' I had learned in the other world was working on its own here as well.

(I've changed. I used to not be able to see behind people's faces. Now I can see the meaning, not the value. This is something I learned from the other side. The two worlds are slowly connecting through me.)

Yeoni wordlessly handed the classmate a can of coffee. My classmate accepted it with a surprised face and shed the tears he had been holding back. Yeon didn't ask anything and just stayed by my side. The end of 'reading' taught by Baekmun was ultimately to be by his side.

This is enough. Understanding is not something grand. Staying by the other person's side so they don't break down. We will do the same in the Palace of Stars. To Seo Han-bi and to the things she broke. Instead of value, side.
And again, night. The dreams now come almost every day. Black rain, a faceless man, a pale child, a silver lion. The pieces became a little clearer each night.

That night in my dream, the silver lion cried for the first time. One by one, the starlight fell from the lion's mane and was washed away by the black rain. The faceless man hugged the lion and buried his face in the back of the lion's neck. The two looked like one.
z

Yeon woke up and saw a white cat by the window. The cat wasn't sleeping. He was quietly looking at Yeon-i with his amber eyes. As if we had that dream together. As if to say, 'It's not time to ask yet.'
You know that dream. are you okay. I won't ask. When you go to the Palace of Stars, you will tell me yourself, right? Until then, please stay by the window like this. That's enough.

Instead of answering, the cat quietly got down from the window sill and curled up at the foot of Yeon's blanket. A beast with a lost constellation and a person with a completed auspicious sign endured the eve of the storm together in one room.

A few more days passed. The interval between mailbox replies gradually widened. Luna's water drop photo period lasts from one day to two days, from two days to three days. Noise began to appear on each channel. The bridge connecting the two worlds was creaking.

[Luna] Sister… Today the water drops keep falling. My hands are shaking. The sky continues to be black. Sister, I'm scared. But everything will be okay when you come, right? Sister, you're coming soon, right?
Yes. Go soon. Very soon. Luna, if you're scared, just float a glass of water instead of water droplets. The water is on your side. always. Hang in there just a little while. My sister is going.
After sending a reply, Yeon couldn't fall asleep while holding the phone in her hand. It was soon. Very soon, the app would ring again. This time, it wasn't a hello, but a scream.

Yeon opened her eyes in the dark and looked back on the past few months. In Jaeseong, she saved Luna's older sister, who was not her older sister, learned the true meaning in the library, met Baekmun, became a human, held Somangi in her arms, and raised Luna as a child of water. It seemed like all of that was preparation for this night.

I'd be lying if I said I wasn't scared. Palace of stars. The king of Jamidusu. luxuriance. And that woman. But strangely, I don't want to run away. Because there is a story I need to rewrite. An ending where no one loses.

Outside the window, a white cat meowed lowly. Like a warning, or a urging. The city's night sky shook once again, and one star turned completely black. It was at the top of the Palace of Stars, where Somangi was, in that direction.

There is no time. That star. That's the Pale Star of Destiny that she trapped. It's going out. Seo Han-bi, the fate you broke and imprisoned is fading away. That's why you called me so urgently. Before I lose that too. okay. I'll go. I have a way to revive both that pale fate and Baekmun’s daughter Somang.

Yeoni touched the water pebble on her wrist, the handkerchief around her neck, and the brush and paper fish in her arms. Three people, three hearts, were there together. Yeon was not alone. That fact was the only light of the night.

And at the end of that dream, the screen turned on by itself even though the phone in the corner of the room was turned off. A masterpiece with swirling black stars filled the screen. The palace of stars was calling Yeon-i more and more strongly.
Episode 29 · Changed Season — The End. Continued from Episode 30, “The Night the App Ringed Again.”

beats.t: At midnight, the phone screamed.
It wasn't a notification sound. It was a sound I had never heard before. Somewhere between the sound of glass freezing and the sound of a child crying.

Yeon-i, who was fast asleep with her clothes on, suddenly woke up at the sound. I've been sleeping like that for several days. Even though it was a moment I had been waiting for for months, when it finally happened, my heart was pounding like crazy. In the darkness, only the phone screen was blinking like a red warning light.
has arrived. This sound. This is it. Waited for several months. please. I hope it's not a big deal.

I picked up the phone with trembling hands. All over the screen, pieces of messages in Luna's name were scattered like broken glass. The sentence was cut off without being finished, and a red 'transmission failure' was written at each point of the break.
[Emergency] Luna: I'm sorry, Yeon. The sky is strange right now. All the stars are black. My sister suddenly collapsed (transmission failed) (transmission failed) (transmission failed)
Luna?! Luna! I can't reply... !

Yeoni tapped the screen like crazy. A red exclamation mark appeared on each message sent. Transmission failed. Transmission failed. The mailbox that connected the two worlds became silent for the first time.
Luna fell down? The sky is black? Luna, please, one more time. Please send me just one more line. Where are you now? Are you okay? !

Reply Khan was silent. Yeoni clicked Baekmun’s channel. gray. I clicked on Neo’s channel. gray. Moka and Luna too. All the passages that connected the two worlds were turned off at the same time, as if they had been promised. The mailbox was completely cut off.

Everything is cut off. All at once. This isn't just a signal issue. The Palace of Stars is closing the entire bridge between the two worlds. The black star I saw when I was writing down my wishes. Well, it's started.

A chill ran down Yeon-i's spine. The dream repeated for several months. Black rain, a faceless man, a pale child, a silver lion. I finally realized with my whole body that all those pieces were predicting this night.
The dream became clearer because the night was getting closer. Baekmoon said that. We're getting closer to the truth. Be strong. I understand now, Baekmun. The truth has now arrived at your doorstep.

The fluorescent lights in the room crackled and flickered. The phone screen on my desk brightened and darkened repeatedly. It was as if the border between the two worlds was becoming thinner, pulling each other in this small room.
Even the room becomes strange. This world and the other world are overlapping. That means it's urgent over there. Luna, my sister, Somang, even at this very moment. There is no time to hesitate.

Yeon squeezed her trembling hands to calm them down. I was scared. Of course I was scared. But something bigger than that fear rose up from my chest. My only thought was that I had to go to those who were hurting over there.

It's okay. I've been preparing this for months. At the library, I learned my true meaning, became a human, raised Luna as a water child, and held Somangi in my arms. It was all for tonight. Come on, Yeon. wake up. It's time to go.

The window rattled and cried loudly. The white cat had its paw on the glass and was glaring at Yeon-i with its amber eyes. The usual arrogance was gone. With all its fur standing up, it howled fiercely at the night sky.
What's wrong with you? What's out there? That sky. Are you feeling it too? Something exploded over there.

Instead of answering, the cat stared intently at a point outside the window. Beyond the city's night sky, one star was completely black. It was in the direction at the top of the Palace of Stars, where Somangi was said to be.
Then the cat turned and jumped out of the open window. Into the dark. As if trying to cross first. As if to say, ‘Follow me.’
Hey, Neo… ?! No, it's a cat! Where are you going! Ha, really. Even that guy. Everyone tells me to come, to come.
Yeon already knew. That this night will come. For months, dreams, the mailbox, and the darkening stars have been predicting this night. Before fear, my body moved.
I have to go. now. Luna, Luna, Somang, they are all over there. There's no time to be scared. You've already prepared everything.
Yeoni opened the drawer and took out the things she had kept for several days. Each time I held it in my hand, the owner's face came to mind.

First, my sister's handkerchief. He had intended to give it to Luna before she was taken as collateral, but he never gave it to her. After getting Luna back, her older sister gave it to Yeon and told her, ‘Think of it as our sister’s heart.’ Yeon wrapped it around her neck.

Next is the original text of Baekmun. A brush that writes only the truth. It was the first item that Noh Sa-seo gave to someone else in a hundred years. The congratulatory message, ‘Let everything you read reveal the truth’ seemed to be ingrained in the writing brush. Yeon put it in her arms.

and Luna's Water Pebble. At the riverside where we were seeing each other off, Luna ran up to us at the end and gave us a hand. It was a stone soaked in purifying water, which said, ‘If you come across something polluted, my water will wash it away.’ Yeon wrapped it around her wrist.

Lastly, the deepest place in your arms. Somangi’s paper fish. Baekmun's lost daughter. The most gentle story in the world. This child had to be returned to his father. Yeon held it tightly to her heart. The four of us were together.

The handkerchief protects me instead of my sister. The brush writes the truth. Pebbles allow Luna to flow. Paper fish... To take Somangi home. Okay, that's it. I got all four. Now all you have to do is open the door.

Yeoni looked around the room one last time. A bag of triangular kimbap, overdue homework, and a half-drinked can of coffee. An ordinary sleeping room. Now I know how precious this ordinariness is. And in order to maintain this sense of normality, I had to finish the work over there.
I'll go to my room. This time I will finish everything. Her problems, her pale fate, her hopes, everything. And when I come back, I'll sleep really well. Turn off all alarms.

The moment Yeoni reached out for the doorknob, the phone in her hand became hot. The gray, dead screen began to shake on its own. The mailbox that connected the two worlds was calling Yeon to the other side with its last strength.
The screen changed spontaneously. The app itself displayed the Tarot Moon card. The card flipped over and the smell of river water came from beyond the screen.
[ Code Destiny ] Emergency Summon — Recipient: Those whose invocation has been completed. Reason: Destiny world erosion detected. Please come back.
There is no need to ask. My names are there.
Yeoni put her hand on the screen without hesitation. The door opened. however.
The river was black.
The surface of the water where starlight does not reach. Instead of gold coins, there were black feathers floating around. Even though the river recognized Yeon-i, it struggled to give way.
The river... I'm sick. This is not like a fraudulent contract. It hurts much, much deeper.

Yeoni knelt by the river. As the black wave passed over the back of my hand, a sadness colder than ice seeped into my bones. This was not hatred, but the water of long-festering sadness. Someone's century-old tears were spreading across rivers around the world.
It's okay. I know. You are sick. I think I vaguely know who dyed you this black. But just once. Hand it to me. I have to go to the sick kids over there.

Even though Kang recognized Yeon-i, he struggled. The black water emptied itself onto the road, covering it black again and again. No matter how much Yeon extended her turquoise hand, the contamination was faster than that. The river alone could not have become clearer.
It won't work. I can't split this river on my own. Luna. i need you Here, now.

At that time, the water pebble on my wrist began to glow on its own. The clear water energy that Luna sent from afar flowed through the pebble and into Yeon's fingertips. Even though the two worlds were separated, water and water were connected.
Luna? This is your water. Are you sending me a channel of water? okay. I told you to let it flow. Don't force it. Thank you, Luna. Let's go together.

The clear stream of water flowing from the pebble drew a thin silver stream on the black river. Every time pollution tried to cover it, clear water flowed flexibly. I won by flowing without blocking. It was Luna's water.

Yeoni stepped on the silver water path and crossed the black river. Step by step, the clear water pushed out the black water beneath my feet. On the opposite shore, a village with a familiar silhouette was immersed in black. It was Jaeseong.

Crossing the river, Yeon recalled the night she first came to this world. It was a river back then too. A clear river where gold coins floated like starlight. The night when a pig that knew nothing was thrown into the river out of fear. The river was now black and suffering like this.

Ganga. When I first came here, you were floating and sparkling with gold coins. What happened in between? Who made you like this? are you okay. I won't run away anymore. I'll go up there and find out why you became like this. And I'll take it back.

The black water became calm for a moment beneath Yeon's feet. As if I understood it. Even amidst the pollution, the river still remembered Yeon-i. That small response was a great comfort to Yeon. This world is not completely dead yet.
is still alive. Robber, Jaeseongdo, everyone. It's not too late. Thank you, Kang. Please hold on just a little longer. I'll be back soon.

Jaeseong Island. However, it was not the lively market that Yeon knew. The lanterns were fading to gray, and the letters on the signs were fading away. People looked up at the sky and murmured. Because the stars were fading out one by one.
Our wealth is withering. This island is a place where people live through relationships and stories. The Palace of Stars is sucking up the story of the entire world. Everything from top to bottom.

Yeoni ran. Passing through the gray alley, I took the path that smelled familiar and smelled like bread. To where Luna is. To the bakery where Luna's older sister collapsed.
In front of the
bakery. A familiar shadow was leading the frightened guests outside. His distinctive bow tie was crooked, but his voice was still loud. It was mocha.

Now, calm down, one by one! Don't run! Meow As long as Moka is here, no one will get hurt! Hey there kid, don't cry. What's the big deal about the sky getting a little black? Are you saying this body will organize everything?
Despite her bravado, Moka's tail stood on end. Suppressing fear and taking care of others first. That was the method Mocha learned from Jaesung.
Mocha!
Huh? That voice... Meow?! Yeon! It's a kite! You're here! You really came! Well, no, I didn’t cry. Dust got in my eyes. anyway! Welcome, teacher! It's not a complete mess right now!

Mocha, explain the situation while running. What about Luna? Where is Luna?
Inside
! Luna won't come out holding on to her sister! No, I can’t come out! Meow, even if I try to pull it out... See for yourself, sir. It's a little strange in there.

Yeoni ran into the bakery. And it stopped on the spot. Between the bags of flour and the cold oven, a dome of blue water surrounded the center of the room. Inside, there was the fallen older sister and Luna hugging the older sister.

The dome was water. A shield of transparent and clear water. Every time the black fog came and crashed in from outside, the wall of water flexed and flowed away. Water that flows and protects without being blocked. It was a shield made by Luna.
Luna. That… Did you make it? Droplet Shield. You really have mastered the art of protecting.

Yeon-i was heartbroken. The child who had been laughing while sending a picture of water drops through the mailbox was now covering her sister, who had collapsed with tears in her eyes, with her whole body. Alone, for a few hours. That small back was trembling, carrying the weight of the whole world.

The water dome Luna created was not perfect. It started to become thin and torn in places, and every time Luna gritted her teeth and diverted water to fill it up. Although she looked exhausted, she never once relaxed her arms around her sister. He was not the timid child that Yeon watched in Jaeseong.
(Luna. You've endured this long here. While I was coming, by yourself. Well done. Really good. Now that I'm here, let's do it together.)
Sister! Sister is here! Well, I can't do it. My sister keeps turning black. No matter how much I wash it, it keeps coming back. Please look after me. Please look after my sister... !
Luna. I saw it. You endured this much alone. You are truly amazing. You don’t have to let go now. Let's hold on together with me. don't cry. Sister, I will save you. With you.

Inside the water dome, Luna's older sister was lying pale. From that gentle face recovered from Jaeseong, something like starlight kept escaping, mixing with the black fog and being sucked upwards. The palace of stars was taking away the ‘light’ of the people of this world from above.
Luna. Stop losing strength. My sister is okay. The power of singing from up there is too strong. Don't let yourself get swept up in it...

Sister, please refrain from speaking. Luna, keep your shield. You're doing great. That light escaping from your body, that is your ‘story’. The Palace of Stars absorbs it. I'll hold on to it. You keep covering it with water.
Yes! Yes, sister. I won't take off my shield. absoluteness. My sister holds me. Don't let my sister's story be taken away from you.
Yeoni put her hand into the water dome and held Luna's hand. It was the hand holding the pen. And I held onto the light that was trying to escape from my sister's body with a story.

「This person is Luna’s older sister. A person who wakes up from a hundred-year sleep and bakes bread again. A person who endured the time he was held as collateral for his younger brother and finally regained his morning. “No one can take this story away.”

The pen blazed with a bluish green color. The light that was escaping from my sister's body returned, caught by Yeon's sentence. As Luna's water enveloped and purified the light, the black energy was washed away. The powers of the two people combined for the first time.
Ah. Stay warm. I feel like my body is mine again. Yeon is a student. Luna. You two... It caught me.
Sister! Sister, your eyes are open! Are you out of your mind?! Hehe, I'm glad. I'm so glad. I thought you were going to die... !

and Luna. Earlier, when my throat was blocked by a thread. Clear water flowed from somewhere and moistened my throat. Thanks to that, I was able to make sounds. That was you, right? From down there, sending me your water.

water combination. Pfft. You are so bright, Luna. okay. Let's do a water combination. The waters of your purification, and the fountain of my stories. For the first time in a hundred years, I can use my water for good instead of bad. Thanks to you.

Yeon is a student. It's too early to be happy. Still up there, at the top of the tower, is my daughter Somangi. And that withering star. Just as you saved Museong, you must save those children too. But now I have to go back to the library. My body is calling me that. Somangi, please. please.

Mr. Seo Han-bi. Just now, when Museong asserted his presence, a strange emotion crossed your face. Isn’t that longing? As you watched Museong become a person, you also remembered something. Someday, you also wanted to call someone’s name so affectionately.

The woman’s eyes shook. What Yeon said was accurate. A long time ago, or in a future that has not yet come, there was someone she loved with all her heart. Park Byeong-ha. At that one word that acknowledged my pain, the sadness that had been frozen for a long time leaked out through my incontinence. done. This can't happen in a place like this. You are a very dangerous child. Break people down with your heart, not with your thoughts. In the future and here too. But, child, reading a person's mind and winning a person's heart are two different things. I lived on that gap for a hundred years.

Pretending not to know. Or, do you really not know? Well, at this point you still don’t know. How many times have we sat face to face like this? How many times have you ruined my calculations? Done. You don't need to know now. You'll find out soon, very soon.
z

Seo Han-bi.

Seo Han-bi. That name. My mouth automatically sang. I don't remember, but my tongue knows this name. You know me. You broke Yeon’s fate. That's why I ended up like this. You know everything. Who am I? Who is that kid? all.

I hugged the little turquoise light in my arms and whispered, ‘You’re the only one who won’t die.’ But it's strange. That girl’s face somehow resembles yours, Yeon. They keep appearing overlapping. What are you doing? Oh my, that’s harsh. I just 'collected' it. There are many valuable things in the world that are unclaimed. Time, fate, fate... Is it a sin to recognize and collect such things? I'm just a person who cherishes beautiful things.

Collection? Destroying and stealing someone else's destiny? You just said that was hypocrisy. Stealing is called ‘collecting’, cruelty is called ‘saving’. If you cover up what you do with pretty words, does that make it bad? no. You're just greedy. And you're being hypocritical not to admit it.

The woman's smile distorted for the first time. The word ‘hypocrisy’ struck straight at the truth that the woman had hidden even from herself for a hundred years. However, the woman soon covered up the distortion with a more glamorous composure. A hypocrite smiles more gracefully when his hypocrisy is discovered.

Smart kid, really. That makes me want more. Yes, the completed fortune telling, the last piece of my collection. Now, let’s go to the world of fate. I'll show you everything there. Who is that pale child, why are you here, and how much do I have? Be prepared, child.

Good. I'll go. Don't run away. No matter who that pale kid is or if he looks like me, I will face it until the end. And Seo Han-bi. I was just shaken by the word ‘hypocrisy’. You know what you're doing is stealing. I will take off that mask of hypocrisy in the world of relationships. Let me see your bare face, too.

Yeon-i. You just looked anxious. Don't worry about what she says about you. no. It must be bothering you. But no matter what happens, I'll be by your side. Whoever you are, you are a kite. I saved my sister from Jaesung and gave her a name Museong. That doesn't change.

Yeoni touched the water pebble on her wrist, the handkerchief around her neck, and the brush and paper fish in her arms, one after another. The four of us, and now Mu-sung and Neo, were together. Yeon-i. Promise me one thing. No matter what truth comes out from there, no matter who you are revealed to be. You are a kite. The Yeon who gave me a name and who looked at me in a hurt light. Yes. I'll catch you, Museong. Look, the child who swallowed for a hundred years is now holding someone else's hand. You have really grown up a lot. No, it really became voiceless. Now, let's really go. To that world of red thread. The three of us, holding hands.

Yeon-i. Today alone, you are doing Let’s Go for the fourth time. I was counting. If I do it one more time, it will be five times, and then I will walk first. Just kidding. A fountain of iron, wood, and stories. Things that were separated a hundred years ago are coming together on their own. That in itself is already a blow to that woman.

Yeon, I will be by your side. That woman is dangerous. He is the one who split me in three a hundred years ago. I don't know what to do. But this time I won't run away. If my real story is out there, I'll face it. With you.

I want to go too. I am now him... No, it's not that girl's doll. It's voiceless. I will follow with my feet. Whatever the truth is, I need to know it. Because I was also the one who was caught by that woman that night. Yeon, I will protect you this time.

When the woman snapped her fingers, the album and the world crumpled like paper. And through the crumpled gap, a strand of red thread caught the group like a fishing line. Yeon, Neo, and Mooseong were wrapped up in that red thread and were sucked into an unknown world.

Beyond the receding alum, at the top of the tower, Somangi's blue-green light sparkled loudly for the last time. As if to say, ‘Sister, I’ll wait here.’ Yeon responded to the light with her heart. Okay, I'll be there soon. Hold on just a little longer, Somang.
Let's change seats. Because it is polite to talk about relationships in the world of relationships.

The red thread swallowed the group whole. The stars of Jamidusu moved away, and beyond them a new world woven entirely with red threads opened up. The most painful truth of a hundred years, and the secret of Yeon's own roots, were waiting for them in the world of red thread.

The moment they were wrapped and sucked in by the red thread, Yeon-i held onto Mooseong's hand and Mooseong held onto Neo's shoulder. The three did not let go of each other. If there were countless relationships that that woman had torn apart and destroyed over the past hundred years, now these three have held each other on their own and united as one. That was the first answer to confront that woman.
Don't let go, both of you! No matter what truth comes out on the other side, let’s start by not letting go! Let's go to the world of red thread! Toward the final truth!
Yes! Don't let go! I’ve held your hand for the first time in a hundred years, but I won’t let you go like this!

The hands of the three people joined as one and disappeared into the red thread. Jamidusu's palace, the throne above it, and the castle below have become distant. Now, all that was left was the final world woven by fate and the hundred years of truth sealed within it. Yeon's real journey was about to begin.
Three in one. Going.

beats.t: When the crumpled world unfolded again, there were threads instead of stars in the sky.

The world of Sukyo. The twenty-eight constellations were a huge loom of relationships that weaved human relationships.

To meet Seo Hanbi. And to save the withering star in the tower above. To do that, you must first read this world. Yeon, that’s your specialty. What do you see here?

Simple, silent. You touched the thread to ‘get’ it, and I touched it to ‘know’ it. Take away the hand that wants to have it, but save the hand that wants to know. This also applies to Seo Hanbi above. Just remember.

Yeon is right. The way we win in this world is not through force. Seo Hanbi has a hundred years worth of strength. If we want to win, we have to do what she can't do. Reading. Knowing. Something that woman has never received before.

Okay. Operation reception. 'If you want to beat Seo Hanbi, read it to her instead of beating her.' … But honestly, I think it would be easier to beat him up. Reading is the hardest thing in the world.
You read me. Seal for one hundred years. So, that woman might work too. no. That woman's seal must be a hundred times thicker than mine. Be prepared.

How about a back? I, Baekmoon, have read the hundred-year-old contract, and I have also read your hundred-year seal. At this point, centennials are my specialty. A professional reader for 100 years. I need to dig up my business cards.

Ah, the real Neo gets the joke in the documentary. it's okay. I was trying to lighten the mood. Everyone is so solemn. Come on, let's laugh. If you go in with a smiling face, she will be more attracted to you. We are so happy, so why are you living like this?
