It won't be easy. But if it's you. Okay, let's do it. Punish, but save. Let's take that girl with us and go back together. To the cherry blossom river.
That's touching, Mr. Byeongha. Is this just a confession after a hundred years? It's still frustratingly stupid, and I'm on the verge of tears.

But you know. Do you know what I was thinking while listening to that touching confession? 'That warmth, those eyes, that kindness. It should have all been mine originally.' … I was that person's fiancé. It was a set match. But that warmth never came to me. Always just for that kid.

Do you know how unfair it is? I have everything. Face, family, ability, and assigned position. But that person didn't look at anything, he only saw that sickly sleeping kid drooling. What am I lacking? What on earth does that kid have that I don’t have?

Mr. Seo Hanbi. There is nothing lacking. You really have it all. But there’s just one thing, you tried to ‘get it’ and I just ‘was me’. We needed someone who was comfortable, not someone who was ill. It's not that you're lacking, the direction was different. You tried to be perfect, and Byung-ha found a place where he didn't have to be perfect.

A place where you don’t have to be perfect. I wish there was a place like that for me too. I was always on stage. A stage where everything falls apart if you make even the slightest mistake. I've never been down there before. That kid smiles comfortably off stage. I was completely lonely on stage. That difference lasted a hundred years.

Hanbi. You can come off the stage now. It's not that no one sees you, it's that now they can really see you. Not the perfect chairman, just Hanbi. Yeon held out her hand. Hold that hand and come down. Underneath the stage, it’s warmer than you think.

No. When I go down, I become nothing. Unless you're the perfect president, I just... You are a shabby woman who has never received love. How can I endure this shabby me? I'd rather be completely lonely on stage. Because that's what I'm used to. So stop it. Don’t keep shaking me!

Mr. Seo Han-bi. It's not shabby. It's not your fault that you didn't receive love, it's just that you haven't met the right person yet. And, the shabby you below the stage is a hundred times prettier than the perfect you on the stage. People are prettiest not when they are perfect, but when they are real. I miss the real you.

A place where you don’t have to be perfect. I've never been anywhere like that in my life. It always had to be perfect. It felt like everything would fall apart if I got even a little distracted. Well, is that so wrong? Did you live hard? Are you trying to be perfect? Why am I trying so hard to get love from anyone?

Hanbi. It's not wrong to try hard. But because you were trying so hard to be perfect, you actually erased everything about yourself. Love goes to real people, not perfect people. Because you erased everything about yourself, there was no ‘you’ for love to go to. If I find you even now, love will come.

Find me who you erased. But Mr. Byeongha. I can't even remember what kind of person I was anymore. Me when I was young, before I was perfect. What did that kid like? What did you laugh at? I don't remember a thing. It's not been a hundred years, it's been erased since birth. It's been so long, I don't think I can find it.

Mr. Seo Han-bi. If you can't find it, you can create a new one now. It's not about getting back the me I erased, it's about living as the real me from now on. How old are you? A hundred years old? A thousand years old? It doesn't matter. It’s never too late to start living as your true self. Starting today, you can find out what you like, one by one.

From today. Where do I have that kind of leisure? I lived like this for all those years, this world is in my hands, and that storehouse is all mine. Now you want to throw it all away and find the ‘real me’? That would be denying everything about who I am up to now. I can't do that. absoluteness. I'd rather end it like this, with everything I have.
That's why I can't forgive you any more. You gave up your body for that kid, but you didn't look back on me even for a single day.

I didn't do anything for you! I was the fiancé chosen by my family, and how hard I tried to be perfect to fit that position! I learned everything you might like. The books you read, the music you listen to, everything! But you haven't seen me even once. I just saw that kid sleeping drooling!

Hanbi. Everything you learned was all done to ‘suit me’. Deleting yours. I never wanted someone perfect. I liked people who were just themselves. Yeon was herself, and you… It was a shell tailored to me. I've never seen the real you, other than that shell.

Really me? Where am I really! From the moment I was born, I was a person who ‘had to be something’! The perfect daughter, the perfect fiance, the perfect president! The real me, I don’t even know! Because I couldn’t afford anything like that!

The woman's voice cracked. There was a huge crack in the armor of hypocrisy that had been built up for a hundred years, or even before. Beneath it, there was an empty person who had never lived as himself. Not the president who has everything, but a lonely person who doesn't know who he is.

Mr. Seo Han-bi. Those words just now are really sad. You were a victim too. A person who cannot live on his own. But you know what? The reason Byeongha saw me wasn’t because I was great. It's just because I live as myself. Just me, drooling, making mistakes, and sharing triangle gimbap. You could do that too. Take off your shell and just be yourself.

Shut up! Now that I've heard something like that! I've already lived like this for a hundred years! Take everything, destroy everything, and lock everything up! If I take off my shell now, there will be nothing left for me! There's just one empty person left!

No. When you take off your shell, the real you remains. It's not empty, it's you who can finally fill it. Mr. Seo Hanbi. It's not too late. Even if it's been like this for a thousand years, not a hundred, you can open your hands now. Let me help you. Just like Byungha helped me find my dream, I will help you find yours.

Hanbi. Listen to Yeon. That kid is the kid who says things like that even to his enemies. It was like that a hundred years ago too. A child who extends his hand even to the person who broke him. The warmth that you so desperately lack is now reaching out in front of you. This time, why don't you catch it?
Catch

? That hand? It wasn't me that broke it, but rather the child's hand that I broke? What shame do I have for that? no. no. no. If I catch you, everything I did for that long time will become wrong. I can't stand that. rather…

The woman’s hands trembled in the air. Between Yeon’s outstretched hand and the red thread in his chest. Will a hundred years of hypocrisy collapse, or will those long years remain frozen? At that crossroads, Seo Hanbi wavered for a long time.

Mr. Seo Han-bi. Admitting a mistake doesn't mean breaking down. That's really strong. If you admit that what you did for a hundred years was wrong, you can stop doing it from then on. That's starting again. It's not too late. You don’t have to hold my hand. Just look at that one red thread again. That's a start.

My red thread. A thread that continues with Byeong-ha and has not killed him for a hundred years. okay. I still do. Still that person. no! No! I won't admit this feeling! If I admit it, I'll be a fool who wasted all those years! The poor, foolish woman who destroyed the world because she couldn't receive even a single love!

Hanbi. It's okay to be pitiful and stupid. We all do that. I am also a fool who bet a hundred years on one triangular gimbap, and Yeon is also a fool who got erased while worrying about others. There's no shame in being a fool. Becoming a fool because of love is actually a good thing. The problem is, you used that foolishness to destroy others. Even now, all you have to do is change the direction.

Stop it. Tell both of you to stop. Right now, I'm shaking for the first time in a hundred years. That's scary. I feel like if I shake, I'll fall apart. So I can't listen anymore. These sounds. I need to get rid of it. Those threads, those voices, everything. That way I won't fall apart.
Shut up. I'm sick of that smugness. I've heard all the confessions, so that's enough. Now let me cut that thread. So that it won't happen again.
The loom cried. The red threads that filled the sky turned pitch black and all bristled like swords.

Hundreds of millions of black blades poured down at once toward that one red thread that connected Yeon-i and Neo. It was the cruelest act of scissors in the world, containing a hundred years of jealousy.
Yeoni! back! I'll stop this!
No, Byeong-ha! Don't try to stop it all by yourself! To carry it alone again! Let’s be together this time! Don't let go!

Neo stretched out silver threads and erected a shield, but there were too many black blades. No matter how many layers were blocked, the next layer pushed in. A hundred years worth of jealousy was too heavy for one watchman to bear.
Now! (Kwajik—!) … I'm going out!

The actual prison exploded from the inside. Instead of tearing it down for a hundred years, it was destroyed in one go with the power of the name regained after a hundred years. Museong spread his black water wings and jumped in front of Yeoni and Neo.

Yeoni! warden! I'm here! The black water I have swallowed for a hundred years, today I will use it to protect you! With a shield! Now, let's all three have our backs together! This time, no one will stop it alone!

Silent! You came out! Look, byeongha. I told you I wasn't alone. Now, the three of you, back to back. No matter how many black blades there are, when the three of us stand back to back, there is no blind spot. You are in front, Mooseong is next to you, I will read. let's go!

The vine, the watchman, and the vessel faced each other in the middle of the world of red thread. Silver threads, black water wings, and green vines. As the three different forces formed one circle, the pouring black blades faltered for the first time. In front of the woman who separated them for a hundred years, the three of them were not separated.

The black blade struck the circle of three people. Neo's silver shield blocked the front, and silent black water wings wrapped around his sides. And within it, Yeon read the resentment contained in each and every blade that fell. It was a defense that was not just blocked, but read and solved.

These blades were all meant to be good together! Seohanbi has been dyed black! Then just read it and go back! This is a married couple for 30 years, this is father and daughter for 10 years, this is first love! They are all originally red threads! Release! Go back to your true colors!

The blades that Yeoni read lost their black color one by one and turned red again. The relationships that Seo Han-bi threw as weapons came back to life at Yeon-i's fingertips and became a warm thread that wrapped around the three people. It was a strange reversal, with the attack turning into a shield.

What is that? Why isn't it splitting up? Why doesn't it break! For a hundred years, there has not been a relationship that did not fall apart in front of this blade! Those three, what on earth are they doing?!

Seo Han-bi. Wondering what we're up to? The child who was broken by you a hundred years ago, the man who went against time to protect that child, and the vessel that was used as a tool by you. Do you see anything in common? All three of us have lost something to you. But we got it back by holding on to each other. That's why we don't split up.

That's right, Seo Hanbi. Every time you broke us, we held each other tighter. Your attack brought us closer together. This is the scary thing about love. The more you break it, the harder it becomes. Your hundred years of jealousy actually forged our thread.

What are you doing? It's simple. We're not trying to have each other, we're trying to protect each other. So it doesn't split. Now, Mr. Seo Hanbi. Now is the real start. Let’s see who is stronger between you and this thread.
Episode 37 · Park Byeong-ha — The end. Continuing from Episode 38, “The Unbreakable Thread.”

episodes.tag: Episode 38 · A thread that cannot be broken
episodes.title: A thread that cannot be broken

beats.t: In a place where the red threads of the world turned black and became swords, the three people stood back to back. Yeon-i, Neo, and Museong just broke out of the prison.
Black blades rained down from all directions. Each strand of thread carried the resentment of a broken relationship, so much so that my heart ached just by brushing against it.
There are too many knives. If you hit one, three more come flying out.

The pouring amount gradually increased. The entire sky turned into black rain, erasing the world, leaving only the place where the three people stood. It was not a fight to choose where to block, but a fight to protect where to stand.

You can't just block this with force. My heart aches. But it's not scary. Because I'm not alone. Byeong-ha on the left, Moo-seong on the right, and me in the middle. Come on, let's back to back. A hundred years of calvi, the three of us will break through.
Stay behind me. I'll block the left one. Voiceless, right!
Leave it to me. The black water I swallowed for a hundred years is now used as a shield. The right side doesn't let a single drop pass through.

Wu Sheng spread the black water into a round shield. The water that had swallowed up stories for a hundred years became a wall to protect someone for the first time. Half of the raining blades were blocked by the shield and bounced off.

Museong, you make shields really well! The hand that was swallowing is so good at guarding! See, since there are three, there are no blind spots. Byeongha's left, Mooseong's right, in front of me. Perfect!
There's something I've been looking at for a hundred years. No one knows her attack pattern better than me. Next comes from above. Neo, up!

saw it! The upper part is blocked by golden frost! Museong, your prediction is accurate. The value seen next to 100 years is used in situations like this. Okay, let's keep this rhythm, the three of us. The longer we last, the better we are. Because Luna comes up from below.

This is how I use what I learned under that woman for a hundred years. It's ironic. That woman raised me as a tool, and that tool was used against that woman. Yeon, I’ll tell you the girl’s next move. When I get angry, it pours down from above. Since I'm angry now, the cross will come soon. Be prepared.
Silent, you traitor. I gave them a hundred years, but in just a few days, they are on their side? Ungrateful. If you weren't me, you would have scattered and disappeared a long time ago!

You didn't take it away, you locked it up. They took away my name and gave me no heart. I didn't betray you. I was never on your side in the first place. I was just forcibly tied up. Now that thread has been cut. In my name, I stand on the side I chose. If that's betrayal, I'll betray you 100 times.
Slaughter.
Vine binding!

Neo's frost dulled the blade, and Yeoni's vines cut through it. The watchman who had been forging for a hundred years, the child who recovered the four pillars, and the vessel that broke the hundred-year seal. The chemistry between the three was clearly strong.
water wall. Right wall, erect.

The three elements rotated together for the first time. The iron dulled the blade, the water built the wall, and the wood weaved the space between them. Even though they each had different strengths, they saved each other and formed a defense team.

Look at this, we really get along well! It is a coexistence where metal, water, and wood save each other! Seo Han-bi, you destroy each other with opposites, but we protect each other with coexistence. It only takes one person to destroy it, but we have to help each other protect it. That's why we are stronger.

It's coexistence. Those are pretty words. But boy, coexistence is slow. I destroy it in an instant with opposing forces, but you help each other and block it slowly. In a speed battle, the one who breaks it wins. It's been like that for a long time.

To avoid losing with speed, we go with numbers. It will increase one by one. Because it keeps coming up from down there. No matter how fast your conflict is, you can't beat the number of relationships that are revived. Look, there's already one up.
It comes as a

number? That's funny. The three of us are going to take on the whole world? No matter how much I tried to develop a relationship, they would all freeze one by one in front of my black thread. Let’s see where and how many come up. I'll freeze it all and throw it back to you.

Well, Mr. Seo Han-bi. Our relationship is stronger and more numerous than I thought. In the castle, in the library, and on the island of food. And everyone is serious about me, so even if you freeze it, it will still come up? Well, this is our first guest. Listen to this brave voice.
Silent, take charge of the left for a moment. Something is coming up from down there. Black threads flock there. Yeon, that’s your thread. Continued from Jaeseong. Do you know who's coming?
This light blue thread. This brave temperature. It's Luna! Luna come up! Look, Seo Hanbi. The first one is already here. Pick up the thread you broke and get back on your feet.
But the loom was the world itself, and in fact, there was no end. Seo Hanbi was not tired at all. Because resentment does not breathe, there is no need to get tired.

If you stop this with force, there will be no end to it. Each blade is a grudge. Then you have to read it and solve it. Silent, Neo! Buy me some time while I read! I'll take back those blades, one by one, to see what they were meant to be!
I cleaned up the left side. Yeon, now is the time. The front bunch of blades, that one is the thickest. Read from that one. We'll take care of it, so you just look ahead.

Yeoni reached out for the rain of blades. Instead of cutting, I read. The blade was originally a thread belonging to two close friends. What was wrong due to a minor misunderstanding, Seo Hanbi blackened and turned into a weapon.
You guys have been friends for 10 years. That misunderstanding actually arose because both of us were worried about each other. Release it. Go back to your true color. Not a sword, indeed.

The blade, which had been forged black, regained its red color and loosened at the sound of Yeon-i's voice. One weapon became a bond again, becoming a thread that wrapped around three people. This was the moment when Seo Han-bi's attack turned into defense at Yeon-i's fingertips.
That's it again. I keep turning my weapon back. It's no use. I have a hundred years worth of grudges. While you take back one, I forge ten. No speed, honey.
If you're alone, that's okay. But I'm not alone. Look, what's coming up from down there.
There's no use holding on. It doesn't matter how many come up. In the end, all you have to do is freeze that thread. The red thread you believe in. I'll freeze it from now on.
The black thread was finally wrapped around the red thread connecting Yeon and Neo. Like ice spreading, the red light between the two began to freeze to pitch black from their fingertips.
The thread is getting cold. Neo, I can't feel you. My hands…
Yeon-i. Don't let go. No matter what happens, don't let go of that hand.
Yes, that's the face. The face I waited a hundred years for. The face of a person who loses something precious right before their eyes.

I've been waiting for a hundred years to see this face. Seo Han-bi, do you know that? That's the saddest thing to say. M I can’t believe I waited so long to see my face collapse. I guess you haven't laughed once in that long time. Just thinking about hurting others. That's not the life you won. You put yourself in prison.

It's a prison. Yeah, maybe it was a prison. But I don't know how to get out of that prison. To get out, I have to hold out my hand, but this hand, which has been closed all the time, won't open. So, we just have to watch others fall apart in this place. If I don't do that, there's no reason for me to be here.

Yeon-i's fingertips lost feeling. At that time, a thread that had been disconnected from the world below began to reconnect itself. It was the thread of support that Seo Han-bi cut earlier. I hung up, but it started again.
What is it? I definitely cut that thread. Why is it continuing again? How does a broken thread come back on its own?
(Below) Yeon is not alone! You wicked spider lady! Hang up? Our yarn? You're funny, this is an unbreakable thread!

Below, in the waterway of Jaeseong, Luna was climbing up, up, holding on to the reconnected thread. Like a child of water, swimming with a thread as a stream of water. It was the first sight a woman who had been separated for a hundred years had seen. A broken thread returns to its own feet.
Did you see
? My thread is connected to Yeon! No matter how much the lady cuts it off, the loving heart continues again! That is an ‘unbreakable thread’! I'm going up this waterway!
Luna! I'll clear the way! I'll widen the waterway with black water, so come on up! I've been using this black water to swallow for a hundred years. Today I use it to help my friend come up!
(Below) I can't send my brother alone. My sister is also riding this thread. This thread is from the person who said my bread was delicious. With these restored legs, I will climb to the end.

(Below) If the actual contract is a contract, then this falls under my jurisdiction as a librarian. How could a librarian miss the moment when a broken contract is re-established? All bookshelves are now open! Lantern fish, light the way above!

A hundred lantern fish swam up again on the connected thread, lighting the way in the darkness. Luna, her sister, and the library's Baekmun. Even though their bodies were down there, their starlight and hearts were coming up on a thread. All the ties that Seo Han-bi had lost were revived one by one and returned to Yeon-i.
Luna! Sister! Baekmun! It was disconnected, but it came back. That's right, this is our relationship. No matter how much you cut it, it continues again. Thanks, everyone. I wasn't really alone.
Of course! There is no way we would send Yeon alone! I have been digging this waterway since Jaeseong. Someday, I will find a way to meet Yeon. See, it's finally connected! Water flows everywhere!

Luna. You were digging a waterway in Jaeseong. While I was here fighting, you were digging your way to me. Oh, I'm really crying. Even though we couldn't see each other, we were going to each other from our respective seats. thank you. Thank you so much, Luna.

Don't cry, Yeon-i! We're not there yet! We're halfway there now! I will sell this waterway until the end. So, when it's crucial, it will appear like voila. When is the water child the best? It pours out when everyone is tired! Look forward to it!

Luna, I will help you with that waterway. My black water is now clear, so you can mix it with your water. When two waters combine, the water speed doubles. This water that I have used to swallow for a hundred years, today I use it to bring friends. It's being put to good use, finally.

Mr. Yeon-i. I'm all better now. With these legs, I will step on the end of this thread and climb up. Hundred Year Ice Lady, prepare yourself. I will receive the reward for my younger brother's cry, like kneading bread dough.

Sister! You're all better! You were so exhausted in Jaeseong, but now you are so brave. Oh, I'm so glad. Seeing my sister recover makes me cry. At that time, I went to Jaeseong to rescue my sister, and this is how I came back. The thread we made back then has now brought my sister here.

Yes, Mr. Yeoni. At that time, Yeon-i said that my bread was delicious, and it saved my life. Thanks to that thread, I recovered, and I am here now thanks to that thread. One kind word goes such a long way. The hundred-year old lady doesn’t know. The power of one warm word.

Even the bakery woman. These are such trivial relationships. You risk your life just to hear that the bread is delicious. But why do those trivial things keep shaking my hundred years? It's not that big of a deal. Just bread, just triangular gimbap, barely the seat next to me.

That's because that trivial thing is real, Seo Han-bi. Great things break, but trivial and warm things don't break. A piece of bread, a triangle gimbap, and the warmth of the seat next to you. That's what lasts for a hundred years. What you haven't had all these years are those trivial things.

Frivolous things. I always chased only great things. Something perfect, something valuable, something others would envy. But it all broke in my hands. There's nothing left. Those kids survive for such a long time by holding on to trivial things, but I am empty even though I have all the great things. What did I buy wrong?

That woman just said, ‘Did I buy something wrong?’ It's the first time in a hundred years that I look back on my life. Student Yeon, this is a critical moment. Is that woman breaking down now, or going to the extreme? Friendly until the end. The only thing that can hold that woman from the edge is your hands.

Mr. Seo Hanbi. I didn't buy it wrong. It's just that no one taught me that frivolous stuff was real. Now you know. Then you can live a trivial life from now on. Let go of all the great things. Take my hand. These hands are boring but warm.

Yeon held out her hand beyond the black storm. Towards the woman of hundred years of ice, a simple and warm hand. Seo Hanbi's eyes wavered for a long time between that hand and the red thread on my chest. At the crossroads where we decide whether to hold hands or not after a hundred years.
That hand. If I catch it, will everything really be okay? Even after being destroyed for a hundred years, can I live again? I can join that ensemble too... ?
Yes, Hanbi. Grab it. It's now. It's my first hand in a hundred years.

Yeon is a student. The relationships you made at Jaeseong and at the library have now come to protect you. This is what makes you different from a hundred years ago. You were alone then, but now you are tied by so many threads. So much so that even if that woman were to cut off all those years, she wouldn't be able to cut it off.

I'm here too, Yeon. Although it's already here. See, for a hundred years I was the loneliest vessel in the world. But now, I'm standing in the middle of all these threads. Thanks to you guys. Now I too am just one strand of this bundle of fate. I'm not lonely. In a hundred years.

voiceless. of course. You are already a bundle of us. Look, Seo Hanbi. This is us. The water of wealth, the light of my sister's baking, the lamp of the library, the watchman's iron, the water of the bowl, and my vine. Six is ​​a bunch. What you've been cutting off one by one, we tied it all into one bundle in one day.
(Below) Hey, Yeon! My thread hasn't broken yet?! I'm on my way up from the island of food! Hang in there a little bit, the encore stage is usually late!

Six forces moved in one rhythm. When the lantern of the White Gate illuminates the place of the next blade, Neo's frost erects a shield there, the water of the silent water wets and hardens the wall, Yeoni's vines weave between them, Luna's waterway washes away the black thread, and her sister's light illuminates the ground beneath her feet. Offense and defense flowed smoothly.

This is a real band! Everyone is so right! Seo Hanbi, did you see it? With the six of us playing together like this, not even your hundred-year grudge can keep up with the rhythm. No matter how strong a drum you play alone, you can't beat an ensemble of six people!

ensemble. Until now, I have always played alone. Because no one agreed with me. So, why is that sound, why is the sound of those six people matching so loud, why is it so... I'm jealous. no. no. It's noisy. I will destroy everything!

The word 'I'm jealous' leaked out again, that woman. Student Yeon, that woman doesn’t hate us, she envies us. Hate is just love losing its place. Beneath that woman's hatred, there is a desire to join in. Keep knocking. That heart.

Yes, Baekmun. Mr. Seo Hanbi. If you're jealous, you can join. To our ensemble. Look, there's a seat here. Seventh. If you add just one thread of yours to our bundle, you too become part of this sound. Instead of playing the drums alone, play together in an ensemble. For the first time in a hundred years, I can make a sound that is not loud and lonely.

Can I join too? Me too, who has been an enemy for a hundred years? Even if I put one of my drums on that sound, won't those kids push it away? no. no. That can't be possible. How many things have I broken? I don't have any qualifications. So don't keep saying things like that. Because it shakes.

Hanbi. There are no qualifications or anything. An ensemble is not about people who are good at playing, but about people who want to play together. Even if you've been destroying it for a hundred years, if you want to destroy it now, that's fine. We don't push it away. Yeon left the seat empty. But that's up to you. We can't force it.

I decide. Then I... Oh, I don't know! I lived like this for all those years, but now how do I decide what to do? My head hurts. stop. Stop everything! Don't give me time to think! Because when I think about it, I break down!
What is this? In this world for a hundred years, a broken thread has never been returned. Why is that kid Silman? Why is my relationship with that girl so boring? What on earth is that kid?!

It's not because you're special, Mr. Seo Han-bi. That's because we divide it. I shared triangular gimbap with these people, listened to their stories, and stayed by their side. So these people also come back to me. You've been stealing for a hundred years, so no one is coming back. That's the difference.

Revived relationships surrounded the three people. The light of the water coming from Jaeseong, the light of the lamp coming from the library, and the clear black water of Museong. The frozen red thread regained its warmth and began to push the black knife away little by little.
(Below) Mr. Yeon-i! I will dazzle your blade with the light of my lamp! Close your eyes, wait! Now, 100-year ice lady. Get some bakery lights! The lighting in our bakery is amazing!

The light of my sister's lamp illuminated the black Kalbi dazzlingly. Seo Han-bi's black thread, accustomed to darkness, briefly lost direction in the presence of light. Without missing the opportunity, he removed an armful of Yeon's blades that were covered in vines.

Hey, I opened it again. What used to be pale is now red. Thank you for holding on for a hundred years. I came. We are like river water. As I became clearer, you also became clearer. It won't wither anymore. It won't break. We both became whole. Oh, I'm so glad. I saved myself.

Yeon-i. Look, that star. It's just like the plan you left that night. As the past you became whole, the broken future you also came back to life. You saved me. Beyond time. For me, that night was a hundred years ago, for you, in that future that hasn't come yet, you made this plan until it was erased. And today, you completed that plan. The two girls finally saved each other.

Two kites looking at each other. Byeongha, I am so grateful to the person I was a hundred years ago. For not giving up on me even when I disappeared. And to me up there. Even though it withered for a long time, it did not die out. The three of us, no, the two of us did it. I was truly an unbreakable person. I almost broke three times, but I got back up all three times.

And at that moment, something strange happened. The revived pale star and the blue-green light of Somangi wrapped within it melted into one - becoming a ray of light that flowed into Yeoni's heart. Like a piece that had been separated for a long time finally coming back into place. Yeon-i stopped breathing. My left wrist became hot.
Huh? My wrist. Here, something comes to mind. The pattern. Lantern fish-shaped, dots. This is a sign of the hope that Baekmoon spoke of. Lantern fish dot on left wrist. Why is this on my wrist now?

! That point. Student Yeon, that spot on your wrist. And that paper fish you carried in your arms. Somangi didn't let go for a hundred years, 'A fish that won't run away.' This old fox folded it. iced coffee. Even though I had these eyes next to me, I couldn't recognize them. Somang. Somangi, it was you.

I am your wish? ah. Now I understand. I, who was broken by that woman from the future, was pushed back across the river of time to this world a hundred years ago. The newborn baby that flowed into the return port. Baekmun took me away and called me Somang, and then she took me away again, and I flowed further along the river... I was reborn as Yeon-yi in that reality. The river turned round and eventually came to me. The thing that was broken and withered up there was me. I was here to save myself. From the beginning.

Yes. A hundred years ago, a newborn baby fell into the return entrance of this library. Trapped by time, half-broken. I had her as my daughter and named her ‘Somang’. But she took it away again, and her story went further down the river. And in the other world, I was reborn. To you. Yeon is a student. You, the daughter that this old fox has been searching for all these years, has finally returned after taking a trip around the river.

Then I have two fathers. Mom and Dad, who gave birth to me and raised me in that other reality, and Baekmun, who first took me into this world of fortune telling. Mr. Baekmun. A hundred years ago it was a wish, and now it is a kite. Even though her name is different, it doesn't change that she's your daughter. dad. I'm back. In a hundred years.

Dad. After a hundred years, I hear those words again. Yes, Somang. No, it's a kite. Any name is fine. Because they are both my daughters. Welcome back. This father waited every day for such a long time. I'm sorry I couldn't protect you. And thank you. For growing up and coming back as such a wonderful adult.

Then, the broken star that I hung above for a hundred years... It was you, Yeon. Your missing half. I stole your newborn time and split you in two. I kept that half in the storehouse for that long. iced coffee. I tore a child in two, hurting them both for years. I have done something that cannot be forgiven.

Seo Han-bi. You have become a person who knows how to regret it with your own mouth. I couldn't have imagined it a hundred years ago. My daughter, I embraced you before I resented you. Because this kid is that kind of kid. Now, you can learn that mindset slowly at the library. The gentleness that Yeon showed today.

At that time, the twenty-eight free constellations twinkled all at once. The constellations that had been forcibly spinning the thread for a hundred years have now begun to weave relationships according to their own will. Surprisingly, the first threads went to Yeon-i's head. Like a thank you, starlight poured down on her.

Huh? The constellations send me thread. Oh, thank you, everyone. It must have been hard for you to be locked up for a hundred years. But you have nothing to thank me for. Because we all did it together. Luna Water, Museong Water, and everyone else combined their efforts. Please have fun in the future. Not black thread, but pretty red thread.

All over the world, the ties that Seo Hanbi had severed and colored were revived. The thread of a couple of 30 years sparkled again, the father and daughter who had been away for 10 years picked up the phone, and the pink thread of first love was carefully connected. The world, which had been stained black by one person's hatred, was being stained red by one person's embrace.

See you, Mr. Seo Han-bi. All the relationships you lost will be revived. That couple of 30 years, that father and daughter, that first love. What you broke a hundred years ago, today I brought it all back with just your first heart. This is your true strength. Not a hand that destroys, but a hand that revives. From now on, I will live with those hands.

Everything I quit comes back. That couple, that father and daughter. The people I dyed black for fun. Oh, I've done a lot of really bad things. I can finally see it now. Each and every one of those people meant the world to someone. Sorry. To those people, to everything.

I'm sorry, you just have to pay it forward. The relationships between those people will be carefully created by you from now on. Let’s start by patching up the torn contracts at Baekmoon’s library. One by one, we reconnect what you left off. Then, even if it takes a hundred years to repay, it will all be repaid someday.

Seo Han-bi. I also lived as a tool under you for a hundred years. There was a lot of resentment. But now that I see you crying, that resentment has melted away. It took me a day to get my name back. You will too. It just takes a little more time. When we meet at the library, it's not just the tools and the owner. Just as people who both started from scratch.

voiceless. To you, saying I'm truly sorry isn't enough. I was used as a tool for a hundred years. Thank you for accepting my words. For letting go of resentment. Someday, I will become someone worthy of the name like you. Not the one that destroys Seo Hanbi, but something else. As for what the name will be, I will write it slowly from now on.

Good. Since everyone has reconciled, the only thing left to do is to live together. But wait, that sky. The light gets brighter. Somehow, it feels like it's coming to an end. Neo? What is that light? Why the sudden mood?
Neo, freed from the pillar, staggered back to Yeon's side. His mane was a mess, but his amber eyes were still looking at her.
Look. I didn't look back. good job.

Byeongha! I'm free! Ah, thank goodness. I'm really glad. How I feel when I see you blinking in the dark. You idiot. And carrying it all alone. Use up all the gold. But thank you for being alive. Thank you for keeping your promise. For holding on and not going out.

held on. Because I know you are coming. But Yeon, you were really amazing. I ran alone through the middle of that storm and hugged that woman. I don't even use any effort. I've been here for a hundred years, but you've done something greater than me in one day. You didn't defeat that woman, you saved her. I’m proud of you, Yeon.
Really, don't do that again. I thought my heart was dropping.
On the other side, Luna burst out of the prison and rushed between the two, and her sister, Baekmun, Mooseong, and Moka were released one by one and returned.
Yeoni! It was alive! I knew that, because I didn't sew it!

Everyone! Everyone is safe! Your legs are fine, Baekmun, Museongdo, and Mocha are fine too. Oh, I'm so glad. We didn't lose a single person. No one died. I kept my promise to God. We all live together and laugh together.

When I looked up, there was no longer a single black thread in the sky. Red threads were coloring the entire sky like a sunset, gently weaving each person's relationship again. After a hundred years, this world took a breath.

Look, look! The sky is red! There's nothing black at all! My water washed the world! Hehe, I guess I really am a child of water. A coward who only worked as a delivery person in Jaeseong washed up the world! Sister, I’m cool now, right?

Besides being cool. Our Luna is the most wonderful water child in the world. But after I finished washing up, I was hungry. When this is over, my sister will bake you a bunch of freshly baked bread. Everyone come. Baekmun, Mooseong, over there... Even the lady.

Bam! call! I'm always hungry after an encore run. Today's encore was a bit hard, so give me double the bread, sister. But really, what is this team? It's more touching than a concert. Next time, I should write a song about this on stage. The title is ‘An Unbreakable Thread’. How do you feel? It feels like a hit.

Can I wear it too? In the place of the bread. I haven't eaten anything in a hundred years. Except what I swallowed. Now I really want to try something. Not talking about other people, just bread or something. With someone.

Of course, silent! Your seat is in the front. Ah, the thought of everyone gathering together like this to eat bread makes me cry. When I first met him in Jaeseong, I couldn't even imagine it. We have become a real family.
That's right. I walked alone for a hundred years, and before I knew it, there were so many. It's all thanks to you, Yeon. You left people wherever you passed. That's what made the sky red today.

Mr. Yeon-i. You really did it! That hundred-year-old ice woman, not with force, but with just a hug. I've been working at that bakery for a long time, but this is the first time I've seen something like that. Embracing and melting hatred. Yeon-i, you are truly a great person. I respect you.

Hey, I just saw it all in jail. You're not hugging that woman. It gave me goosebumps. Winning by hugging your enemy is a completely new genre. Even though I've seen the Island of Food concert thousands of times, that scene just touched me the most. I want to shout encore a hundred times.

Yeon is a student. What you wrote about today is not just the fate of Seo Han-bi. Thousands of relationships that were broken at the hands of that woman are now being revived. Your one hug dyed the black threads of the whole world red. This is the ‘power of original meaning’ that the librarian has been looking for his whole life. You proved it.
The woman on the loom cried for a long, long time. The space where the resentment left was empty, but the body seemed that much lighter.
What should I do now? I survived those years with one grudge. Without that, what am I left with?

Mr. Seo Hanbi. The place where resentment has escaped is empty and scary. Because I filled a hundred years with that. But you know what? Being empty isn't a bad thing. This means you can now fill it with something else. Instead of grudges, people. Instead of hate, triangle gimbap. It has become a blank page. Just like what God gave me. Now you can rewrite your story.

Can I write a new one too? Me too, who has lived like this for a hundred years? Me too, who broke so many things? Will that work? I don't know anything other than hate. I don’t know anything about love, friendship, or anything like that. What can I do with empty hands?

You just have to learn. I didn't know from the beginning either. I came to this world and learned things one by one. How to flow with Luna, how to read with Baekmun, how to connect with Mooseong, and how to protect Byeongha. You can learn from now on. It's never too late. Whether you're a hundred years old or a thousand years old, when you start learning, that's when it begins.
Learn. Is there anyone who can teach me something? I pushed them all away. Who would be there for someone like me? I was alone for a long time.

Here it is. Me. And all these people. You just gave me a hug. That means being by your side. Even though I hate you, I will be by your side. Even if forgiveness is slow. You haven't been alone for a hundred years anymore.

Hey, lady. I really hated that lady. They put us all in jail and Yeon harasses us. But since I see you crying now, I think it's worth looking at. If you make good connections at the library later, I'll bring you a glass of water. With clear water. Water of reconciliation.

Me too. You almost missed the encore because you were in jail because of that lady. That really pissed me off. But, since Yeon hugged me, I’ll look after it too. Instead, later, when you write your reflection at the library, play my song as background music. As an ‘unbreakable thread’. That's the condition.

You guys, don't kill me. Rather, they bring water and play music. No one has ever said this to me in a hundred years. thanks. To this mean me, like this. I will really reflect hard at the library. Because you guys looked at me like this.
That's right, you can just rewrite it on a blank page. Coincidentally, there is a librarian here who is good at organizing empty shelves. There was a shortage of workers.
Are you going to let people like me into the library?
Those whose original meaning remains can read it again at any time. That is the librarian's long-held belief.

The original meaning remains. Does this mean that the girl with that beautiful heart is still inside me? Even after covering it with hatred for a hundred years? Can I meet her again at the library? Can I be that kid again?
It can be

. It will take some time. It's like peeling off a hundred-year coat of paint. But there is no need to rush. There is a lot of time at the library. Just read it slowly, one page at a time. And you, weren't you the one who weaved the relationship? Use your hands to reconnect the torn contracts on the bookshelf. The hand that used to break things is being reused as a hand that connects.

The hand that broke down, the hand that connects. Can I do that? I just hung up for that long. But, I want to try it. For the first time. Not breaking something, but connecting it. Because the child with such a beautiful heart was the child with whom I had originally formed a relationship. Maybe that was really me.

That's right, Mr. Seo Han-bi. It's really you who makes the connection. The one who broke it was you who got lost. Let’s connect again at the library. By Baekmoon’s side, each and every torn contract. Then, one day, you too will have a red thread. It was a real relationship, not hatred. If you come that day, be sure to invite me. I'm going to congratulate you.
Seo Han-bi laughed as if it was absurd. It wasn't madness, it was the laughter of someone I hadn't seen in a long time.
At the end of that laughter, a crack in the sky began to glow quietly. It was the light that brought the time that was out of sync back into place.
Watchman. That light... The barrier of time is being lifted. This means that the price that was imposed on those who rebelled will now be paid.

The crack in the sky became brighter and brighter. As Seo Han-bi's world collapsed and the time that had been misaligned returned to its proper place, the debts hanging over those who had defied time were being settled one by one. The light was beautiful, but it was also a sign that something was coming to an end.
When the price is released... Neo, what happens to you? Where are you going?

Neo didn't answer right away. Amber eyes looked up for a moment into the brightening sky. What flashed in those eyes was not relief or fear, but the calmness of someone who had made up his mind for a long time. From those eyes, Yeon-i felt that there was something left that she had not yet heard.

Neo. Why aren't you answering? What are those eyes? They say that since your name was engraved on the fortune telling, it won’t disappear. But why, the eyes that see that light are like that. Is there anything you haven't told me yet? Byeongha, look at me. Don't avert your eyes. Are you hiding something from me?

Yeon-i. I'm not hiding it. Just because I'm not sure yet. When that door opens, will I go back to the future, stay here, or... What else could it be? You will know that only when the door is open. So don't worry about it now. When I'm sure, I'll tell you first. You promised.

(small) … warden. I know. What happens when that barrier is released? The burden of those who defy time is not that light. But I haven't told that kid yet. You are prepared. A hundred years ago. I won't say anything. Because you'll have to say it yourself.

(small) … Thank you, Museong. Just give it a little more time. I want to let that child laugh at ease just for this moment. I'll tell you soon. Before that door fully opens. Don't hide it this time. Because hiding it for a hundred years is enough.

You two, what were you just whispering about? Museong, why do you look like that? Byeongha, you too. Is there something that only I don't know about? Okay, I won't ask now. But Byeong-ha, promise me one thing. No matter what happens, don't leave me alone. Just keep to that. Okay?

I can't promise that, Yeon. sorry. But in return, I promise you this. No matter what happens, my love for you will never disappear. Wherever I go, whatever I become. I can't even take the time for that one. Because it was engraved on your fortune telling.

I can't promise. What is that? Byeongha, why do you keep talking like that? As if someone is going somewhere far away. I just saved everything. You, Seo Hanbi, and me who are broken. They say they write an ending where everyone laughs. But why does it look like you're the only one left out of the ending?

The gap in the sky became a little wider. The hundred years that had passed to the time-defying one were now about to be settled for the final time. Into that light, something was slowly approaching. A distant golden light that we cannot yet tell whether it is a blessing or a farewell.

Yeon-i. When that door fully opens, I'll tell you everything. Without hiding anything. Until then, just a little more. At this moment, I want to see this scene where everyone is laughing together just a little more. It’s a scene I’ve waited a hundred years for. Now, let’s take care of that person first. More about me later.
I'll talk about that when the door opens. Let's take care of that person first for now.
Episode 41 · The Power of Love — The End. Continuing from the final episode, “Name to Read, Destiny to Write”.
