beats.t: The light of time was unhurried. As if to give them time to say goodbye, the gap in the sky slowly widened.
A strangely quiet warmth remained where the fight ended. Everyone began to organize where they would return to.

Seo Hanbi decided to go to Baekmun’s library. The condition was to collate and return the original list of stolen times and relationships, one by one, on the shelf of reflection that receives the least sunlight. There was no authority to touch the loom again. Baekmun decided to look through the records, and Museong decided to look through the names lost in the seal.

Yeon-i. From the things that made your life a mess, to the time and relationship with the original owner. I'll make a list and return them one by one. Not because I wanted to be forgiven, but because I stole it. That's the first thing I'll do.
More than that. Someday, try writing that first sentence again. Don't burn it this time. Change the subject to ‘I’.
Me as the subject. It’s been a while since I heard that kind of sentence.
Just write it slowly. It took me a long time to read my fortune.
Yeon-i. Can I ask you one last question? Have you forgiven me? Or did you just watch it?

It's not forgiveness yet. To be honest. What you did to me won't all happen overnight. But I decided not to harbor any feelings of hatred. Because if I live with that, I’m the only one who feels heavy. As for forgiveness, I will do it slowly, watching you open the records in the library and turn them around one by one. Until then, let's just be acquaintances.

We know each other. This is the first relationship I've heard of in a hundred years. Not an enemy, not a friend. Just an acquaintance. good night. That's enough. It's too much for me. Thank you, Yeon. For becoming a friend to me, who has no right to hate me.

Seo Hanbi walked toward the library. The shoulders that had been upright for a hundred years were now slightly bent. But those hunched shoulders looked much more human than all those years when they were upright.

Seo Hanbi, who had walked a few steps, suddenly stopped and looked back. I was trying to say something, but ended up just bowing my head slightly. It was the first thank you to someone in a hundred years. A clumsy nod that I can't even put into words yet.

Seo Han-bi said hello to me. Although it is a nod. Turn your head, which you haven't bowed to anyone for a hundred years, to me. Ah, that person is really changing. Slowly, but surely. Goodbye, Seo Hanbi. At the library, be sure to complete your first sentence. The subject is ‘I’.

Museong decided to return to the Jamidusu world. The task was to wipe the blackened stars one by one and return them to their original places. He said he would now restore the sky that had been polluted for a hundred years with his own hands.
Yeon-i. Call me by my name sometimes. I'll practice answering.

The vessel that had lived nameless for a hundred years was now asking to be called by its name. That one short request contained everything about how far Museong had come. From those who devour, to those who are called. And one day, as a caller.
Of course. If you keep your reply short, they'll nag you like Neo.
That's a bit scary.

voiceless. You really have changed a lot. When I first met you, you were a kid who only swallowed other people’s stories, but now you’re writing your own stories. Going to wipe the stars was also your decision.

It's all thanks to you. Because you called my name But Yeon, I’m not lonely anymore. There are constellations, you are connected by a red thread across the river, and you will also see the Seohanbi in the library. The child who was alone for a hundred years now has so much to give back. Instead of being a swallower, I became a squeezer. Voiceless. It's worth the name, finally.

name value. Yes, I live really well. And Museong, don’t forget our promise. Someday, we will all eat triangle kimbap together by the cherry blossom river. You must come too. I'll prepare some tuna mayo.

Triangle kimbap. I haven't tried it yet. I will try it for the first time that day. With you. I look forward to that spring. For the first time in a hundred years, I am trying something called anticipation.

Museong turned to Jamidusu's star path. To the sky where I have been locked up, stained black for a hundred years, this time on my own feet and in my own name. Not as a vessel to swallow, but as a weaver who cleans the stars. That back view was no longer lonely. Because there was a long strand of light green thread leading to Yeon-i.

Farewell, silent. No, see you next time. I never thought that kid would come back so brave. When I first met him, he was a black bird. Just calling her name changed her life like that. One word saved a person's life. I need to call you by my name a lot from now on. There will be fewer lonely people in the world.
Luna cried, hanging on Yeon's leg.
Is Yeon really going again? also? No, but I’m not sad this time. We have an app. Because I will set off a notification every day!
Yes. Send it every day. I will read everything without missing a single word.

Yeon-i. I was a coward who only did delivery work in Jaeseong. I couldn't cross the river because I was afraid of the water. But when I met you, I became a child of water. Wash the world too. It's all thanks to you. Because you trusted me. So, you should come often. Not with an app, but for real. I'll bring water to meet you!
Yes, Luna. If you splash, I'll run over it. Just like when we first met in Jaeseong. You've grown up really nicely. It's the most wonderful water child in the world. We are proud of you, Luna.
Hehe. He said he was proud. I should write it big in my diary today. ‘Yeon says she’s proud of me!’ Now, let’s spend our time smiling instead of crying! Until next time, stay strong everyone!
I will send you a picture of the bread as it is disappointing. Ah, the name of the next new menu is ‘Jaehoeppang’. I'll bake it with the one I'm most confident in.

Mr. Yeon-i. When I was collapsing from exhaustion in Jaeseong, the one thing you said to me was that my bread was delicious. That saved me. Thanks to those words, I recovered and rode that thread to the world of red thread. A single kind word can go this far. From now on, I will also say that to the customers who come to buy bread. Just like Yeon-i did for me.

Sister. When I met him in Jaeseong, he was so tired, but now he is so brave and kind. Sister’s bread, it’s truly the most delicious in the world. I'm going to eat both the Jaehoe bread and the Yeoni cream bread. Take Luna with you. I will go often.
I send you off with a new song! The title is ‘Actually, it doesn’t break’. Did you notice that the thread is a pun? You noticed!
Yes, I noticed it from the first verse.

Oh, it's not fun. Let me just pretend I don’t know. anyway! The chorus of that song is the killer part. ‘Even if I break it, it connects again~ In fact, it doesn’t break~’ like this. Look forward to it because it will be a hit across the river. Please leave a supportive comment as the 1st friend.

Yes, sweeten it with 1 bar. But Moka, the chorus lyrics are a bit cringe-worthy, aren’t they? No, I like it better because it's cringeworthy. It's just like you. When the new song comes out, I will listen to it with Byeongha. Our band's song across the river will become a hit in this world as well.
Your bookshelf will always be placed in a section that receives sunlight. Come take a look anytime. The loan period is for life.

Hey, Yeon. I really changed my life after meeting you. He was an unknown otter who couldn't even do an encore on the island of food, but now he is the firepower of 'Unbreakable Thread', a band that has taken the world by storm. I'll leave the first row of tickets for the next concert empty. Be sure to come. Even across the river.

Yes, mocha. When a new song comes out, the first view is always me. I've set up all the notifications. I secretly liked the way you sneered. You helped me relax every time there was a crisis. Thank you, sincerely.

Ugh, you suddenly thank me so earnestly that it makes me cringe. It's okay, don't cry. We'll see each other every day through the app, so it's not goodbye. Now, old man Baekmun. Say your final goodbye. The person who has lived the longest should finish in style.

Heh heh. It was all thanks to you that this old fox came out after a hundred years and that he regained his daughter whom he had lost for such a long time. It's a kite. You were a child who read people, not books. That's something I, as a librarian, didn't learn during those years. Even if you go back across the river, you will still be this old fox's only daughter. Send greetings through the mailbox every day. To our library's best reader and father's proudest story.
Baekmoon, I will remember those words for a really long time.

One by one, the colleagues hugged Yeon. Luna cried and clung to her, her older sister patted her back affectionately, Museong awkwardly held her hand, Moka loudly put her in a headlock, and Baekmoon just stared for a long time. The path we walked together, from Jaeseong to here, was all contained in those hugs.

Everyone, thank you so much. I couldn't have come this far if I were alone. Luna Waterway, Sister Lantern, Mushroom Water, Mocha Fire, and Baekmun’s Bookshelf. If it wasn't for everyone, I would have already lost to Cheong Rabbit in Jaeseong. We were a really good team. No, they are still a good team. Even if you cross the river, it doesn't actually stop.
And finally, Yeon stood in front of Neo.
As the light of time enveloped the lion's body, its golden mane began to unravel. In its place, silver hair, human hands, and straight shoulders slowly sprouted.
A silver-haired young man wearing a navy blue coat with a star pattern was standing there. The face of a person that had been hidden behind a mane for a hundred years was finally revealed.

Wow, this is what the watchman looks like? He looks really handsome after taking off the lion skin. Hey, Yeon. Didn’t you know that you had such a handsome man by your side throughout that difficult journey? What happened to your eyes?

Wow, Uncle Neo has become a person! It's silver hair! But it's a bit disappointing. I also liked Neo, the Lion. It had a wide back so it was easy to ride. Oh, just kidding! Congratulations on becoming a human!

Watchman. Since it becomes a human face, it overlaps with the faceless man in the black rain a hundred years ago. Ah, now I understand. The afterimage at that time was this face. I finally found my face. congratulations. My lost half and I have now become one.

Thanks, everyone. I lived hiding this face for a hundred years. There is no reason to hide it now. I will live with this face, with Yeon by my side. Not a blunt lion, but a person who knows how to laugh.
Really, it was a person. This was you originally.

Yeon carefully stretched out her hand and touched the person's cheek. It was not the lion's mane, but the warmth of a person. It was the real face of a person I had only met with blunt paws for a hundred years.

It's warm. It's a human face. Byeongha, you can laugh. It is said that when he was a lion, he was always blunt because he did not know how to smile. But I'm smiling now. Really pretty. I haven't seen this face in a hundred years. You may have seen my future self, but this is my first time seeing my current self.

Yes. Now take a look. Because I will see you every day from now on. It's been a hundred years since I've seen a human face smile. I laugh freely in front of you for the first time. What I couldn't do with a lion's mouth, I can do now. Thank you, Yeon. For bringing me back to being a human. It's thanks to you that I became whole.

You idiot. I didn't do that, you endured it for a hundred years. It's okay, we'll thank each other and then threaten the day. Okay, so what happens now? He said he paid the full price. He said it was a good story. Say it quickly. My heart is chewy.
Yes. Now the price has been paid. Originally, humans couldn't stay in a place outside of their proper time for long. So that's it.
So? Wait, so what is it? Is it a good story or a bad story?
Don't be scared. It's not a bad thing.
I'm going to where you are. Under the sky where you live. Actually, from the beginning, that was the place I would return to.

What? Are you coming to where I live? My heart almost dropped because I thought it was a bad story! You scared people with those calm eyes! Oh, really. I should be angry, but I'm so happy that I'm not angry. This foul playman.

Sorry. I didn't mean to scare you. I wasn't sure either, where that door would lead. But since my name is on your fortune, time takes me to where you are. This is what it means to engrave your name. Where you are, becomes where I will be.

So now we live in the same place at the same time. Not half a step back, not the lion skin, just the person Park Byeong-ha. next to me. It took a hundred years. You come next to me. But you came. It finally came.
Are you talking about the seat next to me?
Yes. Not half a step away, but right next to you.

. For a hundred years, I just stayed half a step behind. Are you coming next to me now? Oh, really. Those long years as a blunt lion and watchman. Now you're next to me as a person. good. Let's go to my house. Let’s keep our promise by the cherry blossom river and live a trivial life for a long time.

Yes. For a long time, trivially. Those words are really nice. I lived for a hundred years protecting only great things, but now I will live protecting trivial things. Like your smile, triangle kimbap, and the seat next to the bench. That's what I really wanted to protect. From the beginning.

But Byeongha. I'm not staying here, I'm not running away. I won't close the door and leave. The castle, the library, and that loom are all my destiny. I will live over there, but I will also make this my home. Rather than accepting a safe ending that someone else has decided for me, I want to decide that for myself.

Colleagues behind me waved their hands. Luna is strong despite crying, Unni is friendly, Museong is awkward, Moka is noisy, and Baekmun is calm. And Seo Hanbi also raised her hand very slightly. It wasn't a farewell, it was a greeting, 'Next time.'
The Tarot door has opened. This time, it was a single door for two people.
And then, morning came.

There was no grand magic or loud fanfare. It was just like any other morning, a very ordinary morning. Spring sunlight through the curtains, the phone by your bedside, the laundry you put off yesterday. But that ordinariness was what Yeon risked the entire universe to regain. Not a safe normality determined by others, but a normality that I fought for with my own hands.

It seemed like the world hadn't changed at all. You will still miss the bus sometimes, and the filling of triangle gimbap will sometimes be wrong. But Yeon now knows. How to plant warmth in the midst of those minor misfortunes, and how to get back up from where you fell. Above all, who is the owner of this story?
It was Yeon’s room. Familiar stains, familiar curtains. The calendar on my phone pointed to a very ordinary day of the new semester.

is back. My living room. This narrow room smells like triangle kimbap. But it's strange. This room was stuffy when I left, but when I came back, it was the coziest place in the world. Was that trip all a dream? no. Red thread on the little finger. It's not a dream. It was all real. Byeongha, everyone.

Yeon held up her little finger. A strand of red thread shone thinly in the spring sunlight. It was no longer a thread extending out into the sky, but rather leading somewhere in this room, somewhere very nearby. At the end of the thread, the ninth letter engraved on the four pillars was quietly beating.

Byeongha must be somewhere in this world. At the end of this thread. I have to go find it. Today, to that bench. To my favorite spring bench. It somehow feels like it's there. Leave the seat next to you half empty.

Yeoni hurriedly packed two triangle kimbap. One for yourself and one for the person you will meet today. The warmth that was given to Byeong-ha in the future went back a hundred years, and this time, the past kite was returning to its original place in his hand.

Two tuna mayo. Because I decided to buy it today. Wait, Byeongha. I'll go this time. A hundred years ago you came to me, but today I come to you. You will be at the end of our thread. On a bench in the spring sun.
The phone by my bedside has been ringing diligently since morning. These were notifications from across the river.
[ Code Destiny ] Luna: Good morning! The first batch of reunion bread came out today! (Photo) My sister said she baked Yeon’s portion separately. Eat with your heart before it gets cold!

[ Code Destiny ] White Gate: Notification of new books. 「Night of sleep, reconnecting thread」. In the author's current status section, it is written that Blue Rabbit is cleaning the library of reflections. My handwriting is becoming calmer every day.
[ Code Destiny ] Voiceless: … Yeon. (This is the first notification practice. Did you arrive safely?)
[ Code Destiny ] Mocha: New song teaser is out! link! The first view is definitely you!
Everyone is doing well. Even across the river and above the stars.

[ Code Destiny ] Sister: Yeon-i, the reaction to the reunion is explosive! Customers ask me every day if my name is pretty. Next time, I think I’ll release ‘Yeoni Cream Bread’ as well. If you're embarrassed, tell me~

[ Code Destiny ] Seo Hanbi: (At the 3rd floor of the reflection shelf) … Yeon. Today I found the original owners of twelve glass bottles. I haven't even written the first sentence yet, but I wrote two letters yesterday. 'I am'. I stopped there for a while. I told you to write slowly, so I will write slowly. You don't have to reply.

Seo Han-bi wrote the two letters ‘I’. That's huge. A person who spent a hundred years only talking about others finally uses himself as the subject. They say you don't have to reply, but I have to reply to this. ‘I’m writing well. 'I'm looking forward to the next letter.'

Yeon-i also sent a reply to Seo Han-bi. It was a short but warm message of support to the woman with a hundred years of resentment. Although the hatred was left behind, we were able to exchange greetings like this between acquaintances. That was the method Yeoni chose to punish but save.
Yeon sent replies one by one. This time, it's all much longer than three letters.
[ Code Destiny ] Museong: (You've arrived. There are five lines of reply. It took a while to read. It was good.)

Mooseong said it was ‘good’. The child who had been swallowing for a hundred years is now saying, ‘I like it’ after receiving someone else’s reply. That's really big. Mooseong lives like a real person. Ah, I feel relieved to see everyone living well in their respective places. My trip wasn't in vain.

Yeoni put a lot of effort into each reply. Because now I know how much courage it took to give a three-character, voiceless reply to my friends across the river. So I wrote longer and warmer. In fact, it continued like this every morning.
The season on campus was spring. Yeoni no longer falls down the stairs or misses the bus. Sometimes I walked one stop on purpose. Because I discovered the fun of reading the world.

As I walked down the street, I could vaguely see the relationships between people. The fact that the thread between quarreling lovers is actually still thick, and that a new, thin thread is sprouting between two people who met for the first time today. The eyes learned in the world of the red thread did not disappear in reality either.

With those eyes, Yeoni would sneak up on people who seemed to be having a hard time and hand them triangle gimbap. Just like you did to Byeongha in the future. Perhaps that small act of sharing might draw the first stroke on someone else's blank card. Everywhere you pass, you leave a feeling of warmth.

I know now. It's not that my luck got better, it's that I learned to read my luck. And the fun of putting a bright mark on someone else's luck. The world is such a fun place. Why didn't I know that before?

Byungha gradually blended into campus life. At first, he felt noticeably awkward among the students, but now he has become an ordinary young man who writes down lecture notes next to Yeon and ponders for ten minutes while choosing a menu in front of the scholar. The traces of the hundred-year watchman remained only in the habit of reflexively blocking Yeon's path when he saw something dangerous.

Byeongha, that's just a bicycle. It's not dangerous. You don’t have to block the front. Whenever something passes by, you still block my way to protect me. Where can a hundred years of habit go? But, well, that’s kind of reassuring. He is the most overprotective boyfriend in the world.

Sorry. My body keeps moving first. Living like that for a hundred years. But now, rather than protecting it, I'll just change it to being next to me. It was more difficult to stay side by side than to protect it. But I like it better.
My luck didn't improve. It was just that I was able to read where my luck was flowing. That was enough.
And the bench. Even before everything started, it was Yeon’s favorite place.

In the spring, I cried for no reason on this bench. Without knowing why, I always missed something while looking at the cherry blossoms. Now Yeon knows why. Somewhere in the erased future, this bench was a place where a promise was made to someone. The longing that my body could not forget became tears every spring.

I really liked this bench. I don't even know why I like it. I get it now. This was the place of our promise. My future self and Byeongha decided to meet each time the cherry blossoms bloom. That’s why I come here every spring without even realizing it. Because my feet remembered their promise.

Today again, for some reason, I feel like crying. But this time it's not because I'm sad. It feels like something I've been waiting for for a very long time is finally coming. Hey, someone is sitting on the bench. In the spring sunlight. Why is my heart beating like this?
Someone was sitting on that bench. Silver hair and straight back. And the seat next to me was about half a step empty.
It was my first time seeing him. It had to be someone I was seeing for the first time. But why does the heart recognize this light first?

Yeon’s feet stopped on their own. The head was said to be an 'unknown person', but the red thread on the little finger was already being pulled tightly towards the back. The tears that I shed for no reason on this bench every spring seemed to finally find a reason today.
The man raised his head. Amber eyes gently curved, containing a hundred years worth of greetings.
Nice to meet you… It seems a bit strange to say that.
Park Byeong-ha.

The moment I said that name, the tears I had been holding back came pouring out. It was my first time seeing this person, but my body recognized the name first. A name that was engraved in the deepest part of my heart, even if I didn't remember it.

How. It's my first time seeing your face, but my name comes out automatically. Oh, that's right. Our thread remembers. A thread that stretches back in time. Even though I forgot my head, I actually didn’t forget it. I'm sick. It's really sick. This time it's not a lion or a cat. Park Byeong-ha is just a person.

The spring sunlight gently fell between the two people. The two people, who had been coming back for ten or even a hundred years, were finally in the same place at the same time, side by side. This bench on an ordinary spring day, which I finally arrived at after defying time, crossing the world, and rewriting fate, was more precious than anything else in the world.

Don't cry. No, you can cry. I'm holding back tears right now too. I held on for a hundred years just to see this moment. This moment when you call a person Park Byeong-ha by name. We won't break up now. Neither time nor fate can separate us. Because my name is on your fortune. This is where I belong.
Yes. Now we can finally sit down like this. Sorry for making you wait so long.

I bought two triangle kimbap. One is yours. This is the same deal I gave you in the future. No tuna. A taste that will save the world. Now, eat. This time, I'm giving it to my past self, the person Park Byeong-ha. After a hundred years, I'm finally giving it back.

This is it. This triangle kimbap. The one you gave me on a bench on a rainy day a hundred years ago. I bet all those years on that one thing. Thank you, Yeon. This time I received it by human hand. Not the front foot. If we eat this, we'll really be starting over from the beginning. This time from the side.

Yes. All over again. But Byeong-ha, this isn’t actually our first time. Already once in the future, and once again here and now. No matter how many times we meet, we end up coming to each other like this. Holding hands together. I guess this is fate. I can't even stop time.
I'm the same one who waited. For over ten years, without even knowing his name.
The replies so far have been too short. From now on, I will talk about everything from your side. There were so many things I couldn't say.

Yes. A hundred years worth of stories, tell me slowly. What we were like in the future, what we talked about next to the library, what we promised by the cherry blossom river. I don't remember anything, so you fill me in. Together, let's rewrite that memory. From the beginning.

Yes. Let's write again. Don't let it get erased this time. But Yeon, just one. It's okay if I can't fill up my old memories. You can just make a new one from now on. I liked who we were in the future, but I like who we are at this moment even better. This is where it really begins. The first chapter of our story.

Two people sat side by side on the bench. The parallel that we arrived at only after going back a hundred years, going back in time, and crossing the world. Now nothing could separate them. The distance of half a step, the lion's mane, and erased memories. They were just side by side.

You know, Byeongha. I don't think I'll forget this moment for a really long time. The cherry blossoms haven't bloomed yet, but it already feels like spring. I think this is the first sentence I wrote on a blank page. 'That person sat next to me. That's it, I didn't feel lonely at all.' … It's similar to Seo Han-bi's first sentence, but the subject is 'we'.

Yeon cried while laughing, and sat next to her while crying. A red thread sparkled in the spring sunlight at the tip of my little finger. It was a thread that no longer stretched out into the sky, but connected from here to here.
After that, spring stayed for a long time.
It was Park Byeong-ha's first time in reality. I have lived as a lion and a white cat, but this was my first time riding a bus as a human.
He froze for a long time in front of the transportation card terminal. Beep. Beep beep. “Please give it to me again.” It was a voice Yeon had heard many times.
Look, this world is just thrown away without a tutorial, right? Card like this only once. If you do it quickly several times, it won't be recorded.
This is the first time you complained about there being no tutorial in this world. I finally understand.
Look. The human world is not easy either, right? Instead, there is sometimes a refund button here. Very occasionally.

The first day he ate triangle kimbap from a convenience store, he opened the plastic bag and burst three pieces in a row. After barely succeeding on the fourth attempt, he looked like a strategist who had conquered a masterpiece.
I wonder who the designer of this packaging is. It is more difficult than the masterpiece of the Twelve Palaces.
That is humanity's common homework. No one has come up with the right answer yet.

The convenience store part-timer glanced at him. The handsome man with silver hair and a royal blue coat had the expression of a strategist who conquered twelve palaces in a single plastic package, so it was worth it.

Byeongha, people are looking at you. This is my first time seeing someone make such a solemn expression on a piece of vinyl. And you are so handsome. I didn't realize this when I was a lion, but now that I'm a human, everyone turns around on the street. I'm kind of shrugging my shoulders right now.

I see. I'm not sure. But Yeon, I understand why people buy and eat this triangle gimbap every day. This is more satisfying than conquering the twelve palaces. I tear off the plastic with my hands and eat it myself. It’s no big deal, but why is it so overwhelming?

That's living, Byeongha. Making something that is not a big deal into a big deal. You lived as a watchman for a hundred years, protecting something great. Now live and enjoy the trivial things. Ripping the plastic at the convenience store, missing the bus, and sitting on the bench with me. With something trivial like that.
I like the boring stuff the best. I figured it out after a hundred years. But this tuna, it really tastes like saving the world. I see why you liked it so much.

The gap that the watchmen have kept for a hundred years does not easily disappear. When he sat down on the bench, he still tried to sit about half a step away. Now there is nothing to pull out or anything to cut, but my body took the first step.
Half a step there. You don’t have to do that anymore.
Yeon took that half step with her fingertips. For the first time, the gap that the watchman had guarded for so long disappeared. side by side. Now just side by side.

What the sword that had been forged for a hundred years finally learned was not how to cut better. It was a law to keep without cutting. Only now that there was no older brother to choose, he no longer had to leave the seat next to me empty.
This distance will take some getting used to. In a very good way.

Slowly get used to it. Because we have a lot of time. We've been walking half a step behind each other for a hundred years, so let's walk side by side for the next few years. So it's a rough calculation, right?

The calculation is incorrect. How much will it be worth in 100 years? It takes a thousand years of walking next to me to finally repay it. So, let’s live long, Yeon. I have a lot to repay, so I have to live a long time.

A thousand years? Hey, I'm human so I can't live even a hundred years. Okay, stop counting. Just be by my side every day. Boringly, sitting side by side in the spring sun. That's the most valuable thing. You know now, right?

Yes. Now I know. The most valuable thing in the world is the most trivial. Next to you, I will learn those trivial things every day. A hundred-year watchman, now learning how to live as an ordinary person.

Park Byeong-ha's human adaptation period was a small event every day. The habit of pausing in front of an automatic door and waiting for it to open, the expression on his face of serious concern when he sees people jaywalking, and the way he spends ten minutes worrying about whether or not he should heat it up in front of a convenience store microwave. The dignity of the watchman was everywhere.

One time, he ordered an Americano at a cafe, took a sip, and made a serious face, saying, 'This black water tastes like the black river of Jaeseong.' Yeon almost spit out her coffee. Another time, while looking at the subway map, I seriously admired, ‘This is more complicated than the layout of the zodiac signs.’

Byeongha, Americano is just bitter coffee. It's not a black river. And the subway map is difficult. I'm still confused too. Ah, if I really go out with you, my day will be a joke. The Hundred Year Watchman gets serious about Americano and admires the route map. I'm dying of laughter these days.

I'm not asking you to smile, but I like it when you smile. There are so many things we don't know about this world, so there's something new every day. After living for a hundred years knowing everything, I now live without knowing anything. But this ‘not knowing’ was what made me so excited. There are some good things about not knowing.

Look. Not knowing is not a bad thing. There's a lot to learn. From now on, let us learn together in this world, one by one. Americano, route map, and microwave. Take your time, have fun. That's writing our story.

Byeongha, that's just a microwave. It's not a masterpiece. Just press one button. But this is the first time I've seen someone spend ten minutes worrying about whether to heat it or not. You were so cool-headed in your famous albums, but why are you so rude whenever you come to the convenience store?

Albums had rules. Five elements coexistence and opposite poles, placement of the zodiac signs. It's all calculated. But there are no rules in this world. Whether to heat it or not, there is no right answer. But strangely, I like it better without rules. Because every day is new. After a hundred years, I wonder about tomorrow.
Look. Living without rules is the way to go. Now, let’s go to the cherry blossom river today. A promise we've postponed for a hundred years. I bought two tuna mayo. I decided to buy it this time.
Yes. Finally, that promise. I've been going to the river alone every spring for a hundred years, and today I'm going with you. Let's go, Yeon. Write the best page of our story.
The mailbox connecting the two worlds was still diligent. Luna showed off her sister's new menu every day through video calls, Moka sent new songs, and Baekmun sent new books.

Byeongha also got used to the app. At first, I was amazed, thinking, ‘How can the world be captured on this small plate?’, but now we are texting each other late at night. The two people who were broken by the same person a hundred years ago are now friends who support each other's recovery.
[ Code Destiny ] Silent → Byeongha: I polished three stars today. My hands are still clumsy, so I slightly scratched one of them. Are you good at eating triangle kimbap?
[ Code Destiny ] Byeongha → Silent: It still explodes once in three times. We're both learning how to live as people. Let's take it slow.

Byeongha and Mooseong became text friends. They were both destroyed by Seo Han-bi a hundred years ago, but now they support each other. I like this. People who are hurt recognize each other and help each other up. This is how the world continues.

The world across the river also slowly recovered. On Jaeseong Island, the blue rabbit was cleaning the library bookshelf and returning the names that had been stolen to their original owners one by one. At the library, Seo Hanbi learned from Baekmun how to repair a torn contract. In the sky of Jamidusu, the stars and constellations were stained black.

The world that Seo Han-bi shattered grew again little by little following the seeds of kindness planted by Yeon-i. The world, frozen for a hundred years by one person's hatred, was welcoming spring again with one person's embrace. Rewriting, although it took so long, was a definite task.

Everyone is slowly rewriting in their respective seats. I know it won’t happen overnight. Something that was destroyed over a hundred years will take a long time to be brought back to life. But it's okay because the direction is right. Because everyone is moving towards connecting, not destroying. It will all recover someday.
[ Code Destiny ] Museong: I wrote seven lines today. It gets longer and longer. I think I understand now what this means.
[ Code Destiny ] Blue Rabbit: (Cleaning the reflection shelf) … I sent an apology letter to the bakery. Don't expect a reply. It's just, I wrote it originally for the first time.

[ Code Destiny ] Luna: Yeon-i! Great news! Museong and I combined the waterway to connect Jaeseong and Jamidusu world! Now the stars are playing with each other in the waterway! While Mooseong was polishing the stars, he shot me with a water gun. He's been playing around these days!

[ Code Destiny ] Museong: (Luna exaggerated. It wasn't a water gun, it was a mistake. But it was fun. It was my first time playing a prank. I haven't been able to do it in a hundred years, so I'm trying it one by one these days.)

[ Code Destiny ] Seo Hanbi: (at the library) … Yeon across the river sent a picture of candy through the app. The child I stole time and split into two. Instead of resentment, candy and the words ‘Please take care of Baekmoon’. I cried for a long time behind the shelf after receiving that. This is what a gentle heart is like. I'm learning too, slowly.

Everyone. Everyone is living well in their respective places. Museong plays pranks, Seo Hanbi cries after receiving candy, and Cheong Rabbit writes an apology letter. I got back everything that was taken from me. The name, the heart, and the gentleness. I really enjoyed this trip.
Everyone across the river was experiencing their own spring. With the name that was stolen back.
It was a story that started with ‘A strange app was installed.’
The app still cannot be deleted. But now Yeon knows. That's not a curse, it's just a greeting message from friends across the river every morning.

Looking back, when the app was first installed, it seemed like the most unlucky thing in the world. An app full of bugs that doesn't allow you to log in, doesn't provide refunds, and keeps dragging you into a strange world. But that bug-filled app brought Byeong-ha to Yeon-i. Museong, Luna, Unni, Baekmun, and Mocha. And even yourself.

The unluckiest thing to happen turned out to be the best thing. God said so. The worst things can lead to the best things. This strange app was the best gift of my life. Don't erase it, send me your greetings like this for the rest of your life.

The spring sunlight cast a long shadow over the bench. The story written by a child falling and getting up covered in dirt has now arrived on the most ordinary and warmest page. It was a page written by myself, not someone else's.

That spring, the two people sat side by side and ate triangle kimbap by the riverside where cherry blossoms were fluttering. It was a promise that had been postponed for a hundred years. Byeong-ha still couldn't open the plastic in one go, and Yeon-i laughed when she saw that. Two tuna mayo. The taste of saving the world is finally together.

I finally saved it. A promise by the cherry blossom river. In this place where I have been alone for a hundred years, today you are here. Yeon, I feel like I have everything in the world right now. Not a masterpiece or a storehouse, just this small one.

Me too. I feel like I have everything in the world. Byeongha, let’s do this every year. By this river every spring, two triangle gimbap. Until one hundred years old. No, because you said you wanted to live a thousand years, a thousand times every time the cherry blossoms bloom. how is it?

a thousand times. good. Should I write a contract? I'm kidding. There is no need for a contract between us. Because there is a thread. With this one red thread, not just a thousand times, but eternity is promised. It's a thread that not even time can break.

A cherry blossom leaf landed on the two people's joined hands. The red thread connecting the little finger sparkled in the spring sunlight. A thread that extends neither beyond the sky nor beyond time, but from here to here. It was a thread that had finally found its place.
I learned that fate is something you can read. And from today onwards, I will write my fate myself.

From the day I woke up as a flower pig on Jaeseong's island, until here. All the pages of falling, crying, and being scared came together to become today's Yeon-i. This spring bench I chose with my own hands, rejecting the safe picture drawn by others. It was a page that would not be exchanged for anything else in the world, and was entirely his own.
What are you thinking like that?

Yeah, just like that. Our story has come so far. Starting with one strange app, and ending here. And there are still a lot of pages left to write. I thought it was exciting. Come on, byeongha. Let's go write the next page. What should I write about today?
Yeon picked up her phone and captured the spring sunlight on the bench and the people sitting next to her in one picture. And sent the photo across the river.
「I'm doing well. “Are you guys doing well too?”
Replies poured in in an instant. Across the river and above the stars, friends living their own spring, each with their own voice.
[ Code Destiny ] Luna: I'm doing great! But who is that person next to me?! no way?! More details now!!!
[ Code Destiny ] Sister: Oh my, you two get along well. I'll bake two loaves of bread. Please come together~

[ Code Destiny ] Mocha: Good photo angle! Can I use this as the new album cover? The title is ‘Spring, next door’. Oh, that's right, sister, I'll be on my first solo stage next month. Front row light stick, come to keep your promise.
[ Code Destiny ] White text: … It's a good spring. This is the warmest scene on any page you've ever written. So much so that a librarian would want to keep it.
[ Code Destiny ] Voiceless: (I wrote ten lines. I erased them all. Just say this. You look happy. It’s good, Yeon.)
[ Code Destiny ] Seo Han-bi: … How are you doing? thank god. I'm serious. I, too, will have a spring like that someday. slowly.

Yeoni laughed as she read the replies one by one. Byeongha, who was sitting next to me, also looked at the screen and laughed. On the red thread that connects the two worlds, many greetings were exchanged today as well. It was a spring where no one was alone and everyone was connected.

Now, Byeongha. I replied to everything. Now let’s enjoy spring. (I ranked the stars in my mind.) This life… Five stars. Reason: Life delivery completed. Would repurchase, very much. Delivery was a bit late, but when I received it, it was correct.

This world taught that fate is to be read. However, one child snatched the pen from my hand while I was reading. The pen was still unopened on a bench filled with spring sunlight. There were so many sentences I wanted to write, so I was trying to choose which one to write first.
Episode 42 · Reading Name, Writing Destiny — The End. And when spring came again that year, they still had one more page left to write.

episodes.title: Promise by the Cherry Blossom River

beats.t: And spring has come again. Cherry blossoms were in full bloom on the riverside where the two first sat side by side. Yeon-i and Byeong-ha, who reunited on this bench a year ago, decided to write a special page by the river today.

A white cloth was spread along the riverside, and small lanterns were hung from each cherry tree branch. It was not a loud wedding hall or an expensive hall. Just by the river, their favorite place, under the cherry blossoms. Although it was simple, it was a warmer place than any other wedding hall in the world.
Byeonghaya. I still can't believe it. That we are really getting married. Last year around this time, I even forgot your name. But today, I am wearing a wedding dress next to you. Isn't this a dream?

It's not a dream. Trust me, this is coming from someone who has waited a hundred years. Yeon, I went back in time to do this. One seat next to you. To get that one thing, I became a lion and a cat. Today, I finally sit there as a human being.

Say that again. It brings tears to my eyes. All my makeup will come off, you idiot. But Byeong-ha, you are not the only one talking about 100 years today. I too am someone who has been back for ten, no, a hundred years. Today we both arrived after a long journey.

At that time, a couple in the front row of the wedding hall was crying. Yeoni’s mom and dad. Even though their newborn daughter's time was stolen, they were the two people who secretly looked after the half-out-of-beat child for twenty years.
z

Yeoni's mother came over and smoothed her daughter's veil. There were no words. However, the touch, the quiet love that always came in the form of food and clothes, was today delivered directly in the form of warmth.

That was right then. Between the cherry blossoms by the river, a familiar light bloomed. A golden frame was drawn in the air, and a large door opened. It was a tarot door. That one door that connects the two worlds.
Huh? That light. It's a Tarot door! no way. No way, everyone. It's open! The door leading across the river opened today!
